1.196.m: and in Vaiśākha, Jyeṣṭha, Āṣāḍha, and Śrāvaṇa, / in the month of Bhādrapada, O hero, and in Āśvayuja, O bird,

1.196.s:
mārgaśīrṣe tathā pauṣe pūjayetsatataṃ ravim ..
vibhāvasuṃ vivasvaṃtaṃ bhāskaraṃ pakṣisattama .. 52 ..
1.196.d:
मार्गशीर्षे तथा पौषे पूजयेत्सततं रविम् ॥
विभावसुं विवस्वंतं भास्करं पक्षिसत्तम ॥ 52 ॥
1.196.m: likewise in Mārgaśīrṣa and Pauṣa, one should constantly worship the sun, / Vibhāvasu, Vivasvat, the maker of light, O best of birds.

1.196.s:
vikartanaṃ pataṃgaṃ ca sahasrāṃśuṃ khagādhipa ..
etāni devanāmāni māseṣveteṣu khecara .. 53 ..
1.196.d:
विकर्तनं पतंगं च सहस्रांशुं खगाधिप ॥
एतानि देवनामानि मासेष्वेतेषु खेचर ॥ 53 ॥
1.196.m: Vikartana, Pataṅga, and Sahasrāṃśu, O king of birds; / these are the names of the god in these months, O sky-goer.

1.196.s:
pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ devānāmapi durlabham ..
evaṃ krameṇa tīkṣṇāṃśuṃ nāmabhiḥ paripūjayet .. 54 ..
1.196.d:
पूजयेद्देवदेवेशं देवानामपि दुर्लभम् ॥
एवं क्रमेण तीक्ष्णांशुं नामभिः परिपूजयेत् ॥ 54 ॥
1.196.m: One should worship the lord of the gods of gods, who is difficult even for the gods to attain; / thus, in sequence, one should thoroughly worship the sharp-rayed [sun] with these names.

1.196.s:
ityevaṃ te samākhyātaṃ mayā guhyamidaṃ khaga ..
abhaktāya na dātavyaṃ nāśiṣyāya kathaṃcana .. 55 ..
1.196.d:
इत्येवं ते समाख्यातं मया गुह्यमिदं खग ॥
अभक्ताय न दातव्यं नाशिष्याय कथंचन ॥ 55 ॥
1.196.m: Thus this secret has been fully told to you by me, O bird; / it must never be given to one who is not a devotee, nor to one who is not a disciple,

1.196.s:
na ca pāpakṛte vīra dātavyaṃ vinatātmaja ..
vyādhestu nāśanārthāya deyaṃ viprāya suvrata .. 56 ..
1.196.d:
न च पापकृते वीर दातव्यं विनतात्मज ॥
व्याधेस्तु नाशनार्थाय देयं विप्राय सुव्रत ॥ 56 ॥
1.196.m: nor should it be given to an evildoer, O hero, son of Vinatā. / But for the sake of destroying disease, it should be given to a Brahmin, O you of good vows.

1.196.s:
dattvā svargamavāpnoti śrutvā ca vidhivatkhaga .. 57 .. ..
varāṭikāvarṇanam
1.196.d:
दत्त्वा स्वर्गमवाप्नोति श्रुत्वा च विधिवत्खग ॥ 57 ॥ ॥
वराटिकावर्णनम्
1.196.m:
Having given it, he attains heaven, and having heard it according to rule, O bird.
Description of the Cowrie [Observance].

1.197.s:
.. saptāśvatilaka uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi puṣpadhūpādikāmikam ..
yena yena tu dānena tattatphalamavāpnuyāt .. 1 ..
1.197.d:
॥ सप्ताश्वतिलक उवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि पुष्पधूपादिकामिकम् ॥
येन येन तु दानेन तत्तत्फलमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 1 ॥
1.197.m: The Mark of the Seven-Steeded One said: / Hereafter I shall explain the desires [attained] by flowers, incense, and the like, / by each gift of which one would obtain its corresponding fruit.

1.197.s:
mālatīkusumaiḥ pūjā bhavetsānnidhyakārikā ..
ārogyaṃ karavīraistu bhavatyarthaśca śāśvataḥ .. 2 ..
1.197.d:
मालतीकुसुमैः पूजा भवेत्सान्निध्यकारिका ॥
आरोग्यं करवीरैस्तु भवत्यर्थश्च शाश्वतः ॥ 2 ॥
1.197.m: Worship with mālatī flowers causes [his] presence; / by karavīra [flowers] there is health and lasting wealth.

1.197.s:
aiśvaryamatulaṃ caiva yaśaśca vipulaṃ tathā ..
mallikāyāśca kusumairbhagavatsammukho bhavet .. 3 ..
1.197.d:
ऐश्वर्यमतुलं चैव यशश्च विपुलं तथा ॥
मल्लिकायाश्च कुसुमैर्भगवत्सम्मुखो भवेत् ॥ 3 ॥
1.197.m: Peerless sovereignty indeed, as well as vast fame; / and with mallikā flowers, one comes face to face with the Blessed Lord.

1.197.s:
saubhāgyaṃ puṃḍarīkaistu paramaiśvaryamāpnuyāt ..
kamalotpalakuṃdaistu yaśo vidyā balaṃ bhavet .. 4 ..
1.197.d:
सौभाग्यं पुंडरीकैस्तु परमैश्वर्यमाप्नुयात् ॥
कमलोत्पलकुंदैस्तु यशो विद्या बलं भवेत् ॥ 4 ॥
1.197.m: With white lotuses one would attain good fortune and supreme sovereignty; / with blue lotuses, water lilies, and kunda blossoms, there will be fame, knowledge, and strength.

1.197.s:
nānāvidhaiḥ sukusumaiḥ kṣipraṃ rogātpramucyate ..
bhavatyakṣayamannaṃ ca nityama rcayato ravim .. 5 ..
1.197.d:
नानाविधैः सुकुसुमैः क्षिप्रं रोगात्प्रमुच्यते ॥
भवत्यक्षयमन्नं च नित्यम र्चयतो रविम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.197.m: With good flowers of various kinds, one is quickly freed from disease; / and food becomes inexhaustible for one who constantly worships the sun.

1.197.s:
maṃdārakusumaiḥ pūjā sarvakuṣṭhanivāriṇī ..
bilvasya patrakusumairmahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyāt .. 6 ..
1.197.d:
मंदारकुसुमैः पूजा सर्वकुष्ठनिवारिणी ॥
बिल्वस्य पत्रकुसुमैर्महतीं श्रियमाप्नुयात् ॥ 6 ॥
1.197.m: Worship with mandāra flowers wards off all leprosy; / with the leaves and flowers of the bilva tree, one obtains great prosperity.

1.197.s:
arkasrajā bhavatyarkaḥ sarvadā varadaḥ prabhuḥ ..
pradadyādrūpiṇīṃ kanyāmarcito bakulasrajā ..7..
1.197.d:
अर्कस्रजा भवत्यर्कः सर्वदा वरदः प्रभुः ॥
प्रदद्याद्रूपिणीं कन्यामर्चितो बकुलस्रजा ॥7॥
1.197.m: By a garland of arka, the Sun, the lord, becomes a granter of boons at all times; / worshipped with a garland of bakula, he would grant a beautiful maiden.

1.197.s:
kiṃśukaiḥ pūjito devo na pīḍayati bhāskara. ..
agatsyakusumaiḥ siddhiṃ sānukūlyaṃ prayacchati .. 8 ..
1.197.d:
किंशुकैः पूजितो देवो न पीडयति भास्कर॥।
अगत्स्यकुसुमैः सिद्धिं सानुकूल्यं प्रयच्छति ॥ 8 ॥
1.197.m: Worshipped with kiṃśuka [flowers], the god, the maker of light, does not cause torment; / with agastya flowers, he grants success and favour.

1.197.s:
svayaṃ rūpavatīṃ dadyātpūjitaścaṃpakasrajā ..
nirudvego bhavennityaṃ pūjitaḥ puṣpamālayā .. 9 ..
1.197.d:
स्वयं रूपवतीं दद्यात्पूजितश्चंपकस्रजा ॥
निरुद्वेगो भवेन्नित्यं पूजितः पुष्पमालया ॥ 9 ॥
1.197.m: Worshipped with a garland of campaka, he himself will give a shapely woman; / worshipped with a flower garland, one will be free from anxiety forever.

1.197.s:
aśokakusumairdevamarcayedyo divākaram ..
āmrātakasya kusumaṃ nirmālyamiva dṛśyate .. 10 ..
1.197.d:
अशोककुसुमैर्देवमर्चयेद्यो दिवाकरम् ॥
आम्रातकस्य कुसुमं निर्माल्यमिव दृश्यते ॥ 10 ॥
1.197.m: One who worships the god, the day-maker, with aśoka flowers— / a flower of āmrātaka is regarded as though it were already offered [and discarded];

1.197.s:
apratyagnaṃ(graṃ) bahiryasmāttasmāttatparivarjayet ..
navabhistvacalāṃ kīrtiṃ daśabhiḥ sukhamuttamam .. 11 ..
1.197.d:
अप्रत्यग्नं(ग्रं) बहिर्यस्मात्तस्मात्तत्परिवर्जयेत् ॥
नवभिस्त्वचलां कीर्तिं दशभिः सुखमुत्तमम् ॥ 11 ॥
1.197.m: because it is not fresh from outside, one should therefore avoid it. / By nine [flowers, one obtains] steadfast renown; by ten, supreme happiness;

1.197.s:
bhogānekādaśeneha prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ ..
dvādaśenācalaṃ rājyaṃ dvādaśākhyamavāpnuyāt .. 12 ..
1.197.d:
भोगानेकादशेनेह प्राप्नुयान्नात्र संशयः ॥
द्वादशेनाचलं राज्यं द्वादशाख्यमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 12 ॥
1.197.m: by eleven, one would obtain worldly enjoyments here, there is no doubt of this; / by twelve, one would obtain an unshakeable kingdom named Dvādaśa.

1.197.s:
prathamaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā bhūrūpaṃ praṇametsadā ..
bhuvarnamo dvitīyaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ svarnamennaraḥ .. 13 ..
1.197.d:
प्रथमं पूजयेद्भक्त्या भूरूपं प्रणमेत्सदा ॥
भुवर्नमो द्वितीयं च तृतीयं स्वर्नमेन्नरः ॥ 13 ॥
1.197.m: First, one should worship with devotion, always bowing to the form of Bhūḥ; / secondly, 'Homage to Bhuvaḥ'; and thirdly, a man should bow with 'Svaḥ';

1.197.s:
maharnamaścaturthaṃ tu paṃcamaṃ tu jano namaḥ ..
tapo namastathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ namaḥ satyaṃ tu saptamam .. 14 ..
1.197.d:
महर्नमश्चतुर्थं तु पंचमं तु जनो नमः ॥
तपो नमस्तथा षष्ठं नमः सत्यं तु सप्तमम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.197.m: fourth is 'Homage to Mahaḥ'; fifth is 'Homage to Janaḥ'; / likewise, sixth is 'Homage to Tapaḥ'; and seventh is 'Homage to Satyam';

1.197.s:
aṣṭamaṃ bhūrbhuvaśceti navamaṃ khagasattama ..
daśamaṃ ṣaḍato vīra namolkāya tathā param .. 15 ..
1.197.d:
अष्टमं भूर्भुवश्चेति नवमं खगसत्तम ॥
दशमं षडतो वीर नमोल्काय तथा परम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.197.m: eighth is 'Bhūrbhuvaḥ', and ninth, O best of birds; / tenth is the six [syllables]; then, O hero, next is 'Homage to Ulka';

1.197.s:
dvādaśaṃ tu khaṣolketi oṃ namaḥ pūjayetkhaga ..
evaṃ maṃḍalakārī tu kramādevaṃ phalaṃ labhet ..16..
1.197.d:
द्वादशं तु खषोल्केति ओं नमः पूजयेत्खग ॥
एवं मंडलकारी तु क्रमादेवं फलं लभेत् ॥16॥
1.197.m: and twelfth is 'Khaṣolka, Om, homage', with which one should worship, O bird. / Thus making a maṇḍala, one would obtain the fruit in this very order.

1.197.s:
ghṛtadīpapradānena cakṣuṣmāñjāyate naraḥ ..
kaṭutailasya dīpena śatrūṇāṃ saṃśrayo bhavet ..
madhūkānāṃ tu tailena saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ labhet .. 17 ..
1.197.d:
घृतदीपप्रदानेन चक्षुष्माञ्जायते नरः ॥
कटुतैलस्य दीपेन शत्रूणां संश्रयो भवेत् ॥
मधूकानां तु तैलेन सौभाग्यं परमं लभेत् ॥ 17 ॥
1.197.m: By the gift of a ghee lamp, a man becomes endowed with sight; / by a lamp of mustard oil, he becomes a refuge against enemies; / and by the oil of madhūka [flowers], he would obtain supreme good fortune.

1.197.s:
saṃpūjya vidhivaddevaṃ puṣpadhūpādibhirnaraḥ ..
yathāśaktyā tataḥ paścānnaivedyaṃ tu prakalpayet .. 18 ..
1.197.d:
संपूज्य विधिवद्देवं पुष्पधूपादिभिर्नरः ॥
यथाशक्त्या ततः पश्चान्नैवेद्यं तु प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 18 ॥
1.197.m: Having duly worshipped the god with flowers, incenses, and the like, / a man should thereafter present the food offering according to his capacity.

1.197.s:
puṣpāṇāṃ pravarā jātī dhūpānāṃ caiva candanam ..
gaṃdhānāṃ kuṃkumaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ modakāśca nivedane .. 19 ..
1.197.d:
पुष्पाणां प्रवरा जाती धूपानां चैव चन्दनम् ॥
गंधानां कुंकुमं श्रेष्ठं मोदकाश्च निवेदने ॥ 19 ॥
1.197.m: Among flowers, the jātī is best; among incenses, sandalwood; / among fragrances, saffron is supreme; and sweets among the food offerings.

1.197.s:
etaistuṣyati deveśaḥ sānnidhyaṃ cādhigacchati ..
dadāti pravarāniṣṭāndātuśca svargatiṃ tathā .. 20 ..
1.197.d:
एतैस्तुष्यति देवेशः सान्निध्यं चाधिगच्छति ॥
ददाति प्रवरानिष्टान्दातुश्च स्वर्गतिं तथा ॥ 20 ॥
1.197.m: With these, the lord of the gods is pleased and brings his presence; / he gives excellent desires, and likewise a heavenly destination to the giver.

1.197.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatkṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇām ..
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ bhāskaraṃ timirāpaham ..
āruhya suvimānaṃ sa yāti bhānoḥ salokatām..21..
1.197.d:
एवं संपूज्य विधिवत्कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणाम् ॥
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं भास्करं तिमिरापहम् ॥
आरुह्य सुविमानं स याति भानोः सलोकताम्॥21॥
1.197.m: Having thus worshipped according to rule and having performed circumambulation, / bowing with his head to the god Bhāskara, the dispeller of darkness, / mounting a splendid celestial chariot, he goes to the realm of the Sun.

1.197.s:
punaḥ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ japaṃ kuryādyatheṣṭakam..
hutāśane ca juhuyādvidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ..
evamekaikaśaḥ kāryāḥ saptamyaḥ sapta sarvadā..22..
1.197.d:
पुनः संपूज्य देवेशं जपं कुर्याद्यथेष्टकम्॥
हुताशने च जुहुयाद्विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥
एवमेकैकशः कार्याः सप्तम्यः सप्त सर्वदा॥22॥
1.197.m: Having worshipped the lord of the gods again, one should perform recitation as desired, / and make offerings into the fire by the rite seen in the rules; / thus, one by one, seven saptamīs should always be observed.

1.197.s:
udakaprasṛtiṃ pītvā kriyate yā tu saptamī ..
sā jñeyā sukhadā vīra sadaivodakasaptamī .. 23 ..
1.197.d:
उदकप्रसृतिं पीत्वा क्रियते या तु सप्तमी ॥
सा ज्ञेया सुखदा वीर सदैवोदकसप्तमी ॥ 23 ॥
1.197.m: The saptamī which is observed having drunk a cupped handful of water— / that, O hero, is to be known as always bestowing happiness, the Udakasaptamī.

1.197.s:
yā kācitsaptamī noktā tāṃ te vakṣyāmi marvadā..
varāṭikā krameṇāptaṃ yatkiṃcitpratibhakṣayet .. 24 ..
1.197.d:
या काचित्सप्तमी नोक्ता तां ते वक्ष्यामि मर्वदा॥
वराटिका क्रमेणाप्तं यत्किंचित्प्रतिभक्षयेत् ॥ 24 ॥
1.197.m: Whatever saptamī has not been declared, that I shall declare to you, O mortal: / one should eat whatever is obtained by means of a single cowrie [coin] in succession.

1.197.s:
anena deyamūlyena yallabdhaṃ tatprabhakṣayeta ..
abhakṣyaṃ cāpi bhakṣyaṃ vā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 25 ...
vyāsabhīṣmasaṃvādavarṇanam
1.197.d:
अनेन देयमूल्येन यल्लब्धं तत्प्रभक्षयेत ॥
अभक्ष्यं चापि भक्ष्यं वा नात्र कार्या विचारणा॥ 25 ॥।
व्यासभीष्मसंवादवर्णनम्
1.197.m:
Whatever is obtained for this purchase price, that one should eat; / whether inedible or edible, no consideration should be made here.
Description of the Dialogue of Vyāsa and Bhīṣma.

1.198.s:
.. śatānīka uvāca .. ..
kimekaṃ daivataṃ loke kiṃ vāpyekaṃ parāyaṇam ..
stuvantaḥ kaṃ kamarcataḥ prāpnuyurmānavāḥ śubham .. 1 ..
1.198.d:
॥ शतानीक उवाच ॥ ॥
किमेकं दैवतं लोके किं वाप्येकं परायणम् ॥
स्तुवन्तः कं कमर्चतः प्राप्नुयुर्मानवाः शुभम् ॥ 1 ॥
1.198.m: Śatānīka said: / What is the one deity in the world, or what is the one supreme refuge? / Praising whom, worshipping whom, would mortals obtain good fortune?

1.198.s:
ko dharmaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ kaśca pūjyo matastava ..
brahmādayaḥ kamarcaṃti kaścādistridivaukasām.. 2 ..
1.198.d:
को धर्मः सर्वधर्माणां कश्च पूज्यो मतस्तव ॥
ब्रह्मादयः कमर्चंति कश्चादिस्त्रिदिवौकसाम्॥ 2 ॥
1.198.m: What dharma is [foremost] of all dharmas, and who is worthy of worship in your opinion? / Whom do Brahmā and the others worship, and who is the first of the dwellers of heaven?

1.198.s:
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
atrāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi saṃvādaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
bhīṣmasya naraśārdūla vyāsasya ca mahātmanaḥ ..3..
1.198.d:
॥ सुमन्तुरुवाच ॥ ॥
अत्राहं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि संवादं पापनाशनम् ॥
भीष्मस्य नरशार्दूल व्यासस्य च महात्मनः ॥3॥
1.198.m: Sumantu said: / Here I shall tell you the sin-destroying dialogue / of Bhīṣma and the great-souled Vyāsa, O tiger among men.

1.198.s:
sukhāsīnaṃ mahāvyāsaṃ gaṃgākūle dvijottama..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sumahātejā jvalaṃtamiva pāvakam ..4..
1.198.d:
सुखासीनं महाव्यासं गंगाकूले द्विजोत्तम॥
तं दृष्ट्वा सुमहातेजा ज्वलंतमिव पावकम् ॥4॥
1.198.m: To the great Vyāsa sitting comfortably on the bank of the Gaṅgā, O best of Brahmins, / having seen him of very great splendour, blazing like fire,

1.198.s:
sākṣānnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tejasādityasannibham..
praṇamya śirasā vīra sarvaśāstrālayaṃ param ..5..
1.198.d:
साक्षान्नारायणं देवं तेजसादित्यसन्निभम्॥
प्रणम्य शिरसा वीर सर्वशास्त्रालयं परम् ॥5॥
1.198.m: the god Nārāyaṇa manifest, resembling the sun in splendour, / having bowed his head, O hero, [to him] the supreme receptacle of all scriptures,

1.198.s:
mahābhāratakartāraṃ vedārthanikaṣaṃ param ..
ācāryaṃ paramarṣīṇāṃ rājarṣīṇāṃ ca bhārata ..6..
1.198.d:
महाभारतकर्तारं वेदार्थनिकषं परम् ॥
आचार्यं परमर्षीणां राजर्षीणां च भारत ॥6॥
1.198.m: the author of the Mahābhārata, the supreme touchstone of the meaning of the Vedas, / the teacher of the supreme sages and the royal sages, O Bhārata,

1.198.s:
kartāraṃ kuruvaṃśasya daivataṃ paramaṃ mama ..
papraccha kuruśārdūlo dvijabhaktyā samanvitaḥ ..7..
1.198.d:
कर्तारं कुरुवंशस्य दैवतं परमं मम ॥
पप्रच्छ कुरुशार्दूलो द्विजभक्त्या समन्वितः ॥7॥
1.198.m: the creator of the Kuru lineage, my supreme deity— / the tiger among Kurus, filled with devotion to the twice-born, inquired

1.198.s:
devadevasya māhātmyaṃ cittasthaṃ bhāskarasya tu ..
sa mahātmā mahātejā bhīṣmaḥ pūrvaṃ muniṃ tathā .. 8 ..
1.198.d:
देवदेवस्य माहात्म्यं चित्तस्थं भास्करस्य तु ॥
स महात्मा महातेजा भीष्मः पूर्वं मुनिं तथा ॥ 8 ॥
1.198.m: about the greatness of the god of gods, Bhāskara, residing in his mind; / he, the great-souled Bhīṣma of great splendour, previously [asked] the sage thus.

1.198.s:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
bhagavandvijaśārdūla pārāśarya mahāmate ..
mamākhyātaṃ tvayā sarvaṃ vāṅmayaṃ sacarācaram .. 9 ..
1.198.d:
॥ भीष्म उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्द्विजशार्दूल पाराशर्य महामते ॥
ममाख्यातं त्वया सर्वं वाङ्मयं सचराचरम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.198.m: Bhīṣma said: / O Blessed One, tiger among the twice-born, son of Parāśara of great intellect, / all literature, including the mobile and immobile, has been told to me by you.

1.198.s:
bhāskarasya muniśreṣṭha saṃśayodyāpi vartate ..
ādau tasya namaskāramanyeṣāṃ tadanaṃtaram .. 10 ..
1.198.d:
भास्करस्य मुनिश्रेष्ठ संशयोद्यापि वर्तते ॥
आदौ तस्य नमस्कारमन्येषां तदनंतरम् ॥ 10 ॥
1.198.m: Concerning Bhāskara, O best of sages, doubt remains even today: / homage to him first, and thereafter to the others.

1.198.s:
brahmādīnāṃ tu rudrādyairbrūhi tattvena hetunā ..
ka eṣa bhāskaro brahmankuto jātaḥ ka ucyate .. 11 ..
1.198.d:
ब्रह्मादीनां तु रुद्राद्यैर्ब्रूहि तत्त्वेन हेतुना ॥
क एष भास्करो ब्रह्मन्कुतो जातः क उच्यते ॥ 11 ॥
1.198.m: Tell me truly the reason why Brahmā and the others, headed by Rudra, [bow to him]. / Who is this Bhāskara, O Brahmin? Whence was he born, and who is he said to be?

1.198.s:
kīrtayasva yathānyāyaṃ kautukaṃ hi paraṃ mama ..
kuśalo hi bhavāṃlloke tasmāttvaṃ vaktumarhasi .. 12 ..
1.198.d:
कीर्तयस्व यथान्यायं कौतुकं हि परं मम ॥
कुशलो हि भवांल्लोके तस्मात्त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥ 12 ॥
1.198.m: Proclaim it properly, for my curiosity is immense. / Indeed, you are skilled in the world; therefore, you ought to speak.

1.198.s:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
aho tava mahatkaṣṭaṃ pramūḍhosi na saṃśayaḥ ..
stuvaṃtaśca tamarcābhiḥ siddhā brahmādayaḥ surāḥ .. 13 ..
1.198.d:
॥ व्यास उवाच ॥ ॥
अहो तव महत्कष्टं प्रमूढोसि न संशयः ॥
स्तुवंतश्च तमर्चाभिः सिद्धा ब्रह्मादयः सुराः ॥ 13 ॥
1.198.m: Vyāsa said: / Ah, great is your plight! You are bewildered, no doubt. / The Siddhas and the gods, Brahmā and the others, praise him with acts of worship.

1.198.s:
sarveṣāmeva devānāmādirāditya ucyate ..
sa haṃti timiraṃ sarvaṃ digvidikṣu vyavasthitam .. 14 ..
1.198.d:
सर्वेषामेव देवानामादिरादित्य उच्यते ॥
स हंति तिमिरं सर्वं दिग्विदिक्षु व्यवस्थितम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.198.m: Āditya is called the first of all the gods. / He destroys all the darkness situated in the cardinal and intermediate directions.

1.198.s:
sa dharmaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ sa ca pūjyatamo mataḥ ..
brahmādayastamarcaṃti sa cādistridivaukasām .. 15 ..
1.198.d:
स धर्मः सर्वधर्माणां स च पूज्यतमो मतः ॥
ब्रह्मादयस्तमर्चंति स चादिस्त्रिदिवौकसाम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.198.m: He is the righteousness of all righteous duties, and he is considered the most worthy of worship. / Brahmā and the others worship him, and he is the beginning of the dwellers of heaven.

1.198.s:
aditiḥ kaśyapasatī ādityastena cocyate ..
ādikartātha vā yasmā ttasmādāditya ucyate .. 16 ..
1.198.d:
अदितिः कश्यपसती आदित्यस्तेन चोच्यते ॥
आदिकर्ताथ वा यस्मा त्तस्मादादित्य उच्यते ॥ 16 ॥
1.198.m: Aditi was the virtuous wife of Kaśyapa, and therefore he is called Āditya; / or because he is the primeval creator (ādikartṛ), therefore is he called Āditya.

1.198.s:
tasmādetajjagatsarvamādityātsaṃpravartate ..
sadevāsuragaṃdharvaṃ sayakṣoragarākṣasam .. 17 ..
1.198.d:
तस्मादेतज्जगत्सर्वमादित्यात्संप्रवर्तते ॥
सदेवासुरगंधर्वं सयक्षोरगराक्षसम् ॥ 17 ॥
1.198.m: Therefore, this entire universe proceeds from Āditya, / together with gods, asuras, and gandharvas, together with yakṣas, uragas, and rākṣasas.

1.198.s:
rudropeṃdrau tatheṃdraśca brahmā dakṣotha kaśyapaḥ ..
ādityadevatāḥ sarve tathānye devadānavāḥ .. 18 ..
1.198.d:
रुद्रोपेंद्रौ तथेंद्रश्च ब्रह्मा दक्षोथ कश्यपः ॥
आदित्यदेवताः सर्वे तथान्ये देवदानवाः ॥ 18 ॥
1.198.m: Rudra, Upendra, as well as Indra, Brahmā, Dakṣa, and then Kaśyapa— / all have Āditya as their deity, as do the other gods and dānavas.

1.198.s:
mukhādbhūto viriṃcistu rudro vakṣasthalāttataḥ ..
upeṃdro dakṣiṇāddhastāddhātā vāmakarāttathā .. 19 ..
1.198.d:
मुखाद्भूतो विरिंचिस्तु रुद्रो वक्षस्थलात्ततः ॥
उपेंद्रो दक्षिणाद्धस्ताद्धाता वामकरात्तथा ॥ 19 ॥
1.198.m: Viriñci arose from his mouth, and then Rudra from the region of his chest; / Upendra from his right hand, and Dhātṛ likewise from his left hand;

1.198.s:
vāmapādatalāddakṣo dakṣiṇātkaśyapastathā ..
ityutpannāstathā cānye devāsuranarāḥ khagāḥ ..
tenāsau deva ādityaḥ sarvadeveṣu pūjitaḥ ..20..
1.198.d:
वामपादतलाद्दक्षो दक्षिणात्कश्यपस्तथा ॥
इत्युत्पन्नास्तथा चान्ये देवासुरनराः खगाः ॥
तेनासौ देव आदित्यः सर्वदेवेषु पूजितः ॥20॥
1.198.m: Dakṣa from the sole of his left foot, and Kaśyapa from the right. / Thus were they born, and so too other gods, asuras, humans, and birds. / By that [creator], this god Āditya is worshipped among all gods.

1.198.s:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
yadītthaṃ gīyate vīra digvidikṣu sa bhāskaraḥ ..
yadi tasya prabhāvoyaṃ pārāśarya jagatpateḥ ..21..
1.198.d:
॥ भीष्म उवाच ॥ ॥
यदीत्थं गीयते वीर दिग्विदिक्षु स भास्करः ॥
यदि तस्य प्रभावोयं पाराशर्य जगत्पतेः ॥21॥
1.198.m: Bhīṣma said: / If that Bhāskara is praised in this way in the cardinal and intermediate directions, O hero, / if this is the majesty of that lord of the universe, O son of Parāśara,

1.198.s:
sa kimarthaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ tu rākṣasaiḥ paribhūyate ..
dvijaiḥ saṃrakṣyate bhūyaścakravadbhramate punaḥ ..
rāhuṇā gṛhyate'grāhyastatkimarthaṃ dvijottama ..22..
1.198.d:
स किमर्थं त्रिसंध्यं तु राक्षसैः परिभूयते ॥
द्विजैः संरक्ष्यते भूयश्चक्रवद्भ्रमते पुनः ॥
राहुणा गृह्यतेऽग्राह्यस्तत्किमर्थं द्विजोत्तम ॥22॥
1.198.m: why then is he overcome by rākṣasas at the three junctures of the day, / protected repeatedly by twice-borns, and turns again like a wheel, / and is seized by Rāhu, though unseizable? Why is that, O best of the twice-born?

1.198.s:
..vyāsa uvāca .. ..
piśācoragarakṣāṃsi ḍākinīdānavāṃstathā ..
dakṣiṇāgnirdahetkrodhāttamākrāmati bhāskaraḥ .. 23 ..
1.198.d:
॥व्यास उवाच ॥ ॥
पिशाचोरगरक्षांसि डाकिनीदानवांस्तथा ॥
दक्षिणाग्निर्दहेत्क्रोधात्तमाक्रामति भास्करः ॥ 23 ॥
1.198.m: Vyāsa said: / Piśācas, uragas, and rakṣases, as well as ḍākinīs and dānavas, / the southern fire burns in anger, and Bhāskara traverses them.

1.198.s:
trisaṃdhyaṃ tu trayo devāḥ sānnidhyaṃ ravimaṃḍale ..
muhūrtasya prabhāvoyamasādhye dṛṣṭake tathā .. 24 ..
1.198.d:
त्रिसंध्यं तु त्रयो देवाः सान्निध्यं रविमंडले ॥
मुहूर्तस्य प्रभावोयमसाध्ये दृष्टके तथा ॥ 24 ॥
1.198.m: At the three junctures of the day, the three gods are present in the disc of the sun. / This is the power of a muhūrta, and likewise when [a misfortune] seen is incurable.

1.198.s:
tamekamevamuddiśya loke dharmaḥ pravartate ..
namaskṛte stute tasminsarve devā namaskṛtāḥ .. 25 ..
1.198.d:
तमेकमेवमुद्दिश्य लोके धर्मः प्रवर्तते ॥
नमस्कृते स्तुते तस्मिन्सर्वे देवा नमस्कृताः ॥ 25 ॥
1.198.m: Intending him alone, righteousness operates in the world. / When he is saluted and praised, all the gods are saluted.

1.198.s:
trisandhyaṃ vasudhādevairbhāskarastriḥ praṇamyate ..
rāhurādityabiṃbasya sthitodhastānna saṃśayaḥ .. 26 ..
1.198.d:
त्रिसन्ध्यं वसुधादेवैर्भास्करस्त्रिः प्रणम्यते ॥
राहुरादित्यबिंबस्य स्थितोधस्तान्न संशयः ॥ 26 ॥
1.198.m: At the three junctures of the day, Bhāskara is bowed to thrice by the gods on earth. / Rāhu is situated below the disc of Āditya, without a doubt.

1.198.s:
amṛtārthī vimānastho yāvatsaṃsravate'mṛtam ..
vimānāṃtaritaṃ biṃbamādiśedgrahaṇaṃ tataḥ .. 27 ..
1.198.d:
अमृतार्थी विमानस्थो यावत्संस्रवतेऽमृतम् ॥
विमानांतरितं बिंबमादिशेद्ग्रहणं ततः ॥ 27 ॥
1.198.m: Desiring nectar, he stands in a celestial chariot so long as the nectar flows down; / since the disc is obscured by the celestial chariot, an eclipse is then announced.

1.198.s:
na kaściddharṣituṃ śakta ādityo dahate dhruvam ..
divārātrimuhūrtānāṃ jñānāyākramate raviḥ..28..
1.198.d:
न कश्चिद्धर्षितुं शक्त आदित्यो दहते ध्रुवम् ॥
दिवारात्रिमुहूर्तानां ज्ञानायाक्रमते रविः॥28॥
1.198.m: No one is able to overpower him; Āditya burns steadily. / Ravi traverses for the knowledge of days, nights, and muhūrtas.

1.198.s:
nādityena vinā rātrirna dinaṃ na ca tarpaṇam ..
nādharmmo nātha vā dharmmastena dṛṣṭaṃ carācaram .. 29 ..
1.198.d:
नादित्येन विना रात्रिर्न दिनं न च तर्पणम् ॥
नाधर्म्मो नाथ वा धर्म्मस्तेन दृष्टं चराचरम् ॥ 29 ॥
1.198.m: Without Āditya there is no night, no day, and no water-offering; / neither is there unrighteousness nor righteousness; by him the moving and unmoving is seen.

1.198.s:
ādityaḥ pāti vai sarvamādityaḥ sṛjate sadā ..
etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ bhavatā mama .. 30 .. ..
bhīṣmavyāsasaṃvādavarṇanam
1.198.d:
आदित्यः पाति वै सर्वमादित्यः सृजते सदा ॥
एतत्सर्वं समाख्यातं यत्पृष्टं भवता मम ॥ 30 ॥ ॥
भीष्मव्याससंवादवर्णनम्
1.198.m:
Āditya indeed protects everything, Āditya creates perpetually. / All this has been fully recounted, which was asked of me by you.
Description of the Dialogue Between Bhīṣma and Vyāsa

1.199.s:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
sa ādityo bhavedyena acirāttu varapradaḥ ..
tadahaṃśrotumicchāmi vipra māṃ brūhi tattvataḥ .. 1 ..
1.199.d:
॥ भीष्म उवाच ॥ ॥
स आदित्यो भवेद्येन अचिरात्तु वरप्रदः ॥
तदहंश्रोतुमिच्छामि विप्र मां ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः ॥ 1 ॥
1.199.m: Bhīṣma said: / Tell me truly, O Brahmin, for I wish to hear: / how does that Āditya quickly become a granter of boons?

1.199.s:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
pūjayā japahomena dhyānadhāraṇayā saha ..
sakalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā taddīkṣā samayaṃ tathā .. 2 ..
1.199.d:
॥ व्यास उवाच ॥ ॥
पूजया जपहोमेन ध्यानधारणया सह ॥
सकलं मण्डलं कृत्वा तद्दीक्षा समयं तथा ॥ 2 ॥
1.199.m: Vyāsa said: / Through worship, recitation, and oblation, along with meditation and concentration, / having made the complete maṇḍala, and likewise having obtained its initiation

1.199.s:
labdhvā rādhayate yastu bhaktyā tadgatamānasaḥ ..
tasya bhānurbhavedvīra acirāttu varapradaḥ .. 3 ..
1.199.d:
लब्ध्वा राधयते यस्तु भक्त्या तद्गतमानसः ॥
तस्य भानुर्भवेद्वीर अचिरात्तु वरप्रदः ॥ 3 ॥
1.199.m: and vows, he who worships [him] with devotion, his mind fixed upon him— / for him, O hero, the Sun quickly becomes a granter of boons.

1.199.s:
balasiddhiṃ mahadvīryaṃ pratāpaṃ ca svakāyanam ..
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca rūpaṃ saubhāgyasaṃpadam .. 4 ..
1.199.d:
बलसिद्धिं महद्वीर्यं प्रतापं च स्वकायनम् ॥
धनं धान्यं सुवर्णं च रूपं सौभाग्यसंपदम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.199.m: Attainment of strength, great valour, majesty, and a fine body of one's own, / wealth, grain, gold, beauty, and the wealth of good fortune,

1.199.s:
ārogyamāyuḥ kīrtiṃ ca yaśaḥ putrāṃśca mānada ..
dadate nātra saṃdeho yasya tuṣṭo divākaraḥ .. 5 ..
1.199.d:
आरोग्यमायुः कीर्तिं च यशः पुत्रांश्च मानद ॥
ददते नात्र संदेहो यस्य तुष्टो दिवाकरः ॥ 5 ॥
1.199.m: health, lifespan, fame, renown, and sons, O giver of honour— / he grants these, there is no doubt, to one with whom the Day-maker is pleased.

1.199.s:
dharmamarthaṃ tathā kāmaṃ vidyāṃ mokṣaśriyaṃ tathā ..
dadate bhāskarastuṣṭo narāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 6 ..
1.199.d:
धर्ममर्थं तथा कामं विद्यां मोक्षश्रियं तथा ॥
ददते भास्करस्तुष्टो नराणां नात्र संशयः ॥ 6 ॥
1.199.m: Righteousness, wealth, desire, knowledge, and the splendour of liberation— / when pleased, Bhāskara grants these to men, there is no doubt.

1.199.s:
saureṇa vidhinā tāta pūjayitvā divākaram ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti tathādityālayaṃ nṛpa .. 7 ..
1.199.d:
सौरेण विधिना तात पूजयित्वा दिवाकरम् ॥
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति तथादित्यालयं नृप ॥ 7 ॥
1.199.m: Having worshipped the Day-maker according to the Saura rule, my dear, / a king obtains all desires, and likewise the abode of Āditya.

1.199.s:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
saurasnānavidhiṃ brūhi sarahasyaṃ mahāmate ..
yena snāto'malo yāti naraḥ pūja yituṃ ravim .. 8 ..
1.199.d:
॥ भीष्म उवाच ॥ ॥
सौरस्नानविधिं ब्रूहि सरहस्यं महामते ॥
येन स्नातोऽमलो याति नरः पूज यितुं रविम् ॥ 8 ॥
1.199.m: Bhīṣma said: / Tell me, O highly intelligent one, the rule of Saura bathing together with its secret, / bathed by which, stainless, a man goes to worship Ravi.

1.199.s:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
haṃta te saṃpravakṣyāmi snānaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
śucau manorame sthāne saṃgṛhyāstreṇa mṛttikām ..9 ..
1.199.d:
॥ व्यास उवाच ॥ ॥
हंत ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि स्नानं पापप्रणाशनम् ॥
शुचौ मनोरमे स्थाने संगृह्यास्त्रेण मृत्तिकाम् ॥9 ॥
1.199.m: Vyāsa said: / Well then, I shall tell you of the bath that destroys sins: / having gathered clay with the Astra [mantra] in a pure and pleasant place,

1.199.s:
saṃdhisaṃgho hakārastu ṭarephophasamanvite ..
anenāstreṇa saṃgṛhya tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret .. 10..
1.199.d:
संधिसंघो हकारस्तु टरेफोफसमन्विते ॥
अनेनास्त्रेण संगृह्य ततः स्नानं समाचरेत् ॥ 10॥
1.199.m: the juncture-conjunction, the syllable ha, combined with ṭa, the letter ra, and pha— / having taken it with this Astra [mantra], one should then perform the bath.

1.199.s:
malasnānaṃ tataḥ paścāccheṣārdhena tu kārayet ..
bhāgatrayaṃ tu sārdhaṃ tu tṛṇapāṣāṇavarjitam .. 11 ..
1.199.d:
मलस्नानं ततः पश्चाच्छेषार्धेन तु कारयेत् ॥
भागत्रयं तु सार्धं तु तृणपाषाणवर्जितम् ॥ 11 ॥
1.199.m: Then, after that, one should cause the dirt-cleansing bath with the remaining half. / [Divide the clay into] three parts, free of grass and stones;

1.199.s:
ekamastreṇa cālabhya tathānyaṃ bhāskareṇa tu ..
aṃgaṃ caiva tṛtīyena abhimaṃtrya sakṛtsakṛt .. 12 ..
1.199.d:
एकमस्त्रेण चालभ्य तथान्यं भास्करेण तु ॥
अंगं चैव तृतीयेन अभिमंत्र्य सकृत्सकृत् ॥ 12 ॥
1.199.m: having smeared one [part] with the Astra [mantra], and another with the Bhāskara [mantra], / and [smearing] the body with the third, having consecrated [each] once;

1.199.s:
japtvāstreṇa kṣipeddikṣu nirvighnaṃ tu jalaṃ bhavet ..
sūryatīrthe dvitīyena abhimaṃtrya sakṛtsakṛt .. 13 ..
1.199.d:
जप्त्वास्त्रेण क्षिपेद्दिक्षु निर्विघ्नं तु जलं भवेत् ॥
सूर्यतीर्थे द्वितीयेन अभिमंत्र्य सकृत्सकृत् ॥ 13 ॥
1.199.m: having recited [the mantra], one should throw [water] in the directions with the Astra [mantra], and the water will become free from obstacles. / Having consecrated [the water] at the sacred bathing place of Sūrya with the second [mantra] once,

1.199.s:
gu(mu)ṇḍayitvā tataḥ snāyāditi tīrtheṣu mānavaḥ ..
tūryaśaṃkhaninādena dhyātvā devaṃ divākaram .. 14 ..
1.199.d:
गु(मु)ण्डयित्वा ततः स्नायादिति तीर्थेषु मानवः ॥
तूर्यशंखनिनादेन ध्यात्वा देवं दिवाकरम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.199.m: and having shaved his head, a man should then bathe in such sacred waters, / meditating on the god Divākara to the sound of trumpets and conches.

1.199.s:
snātvā rājopacāreṇa punarācamya yatnataḥ ..
snānaṃ kṛtvā tato bhīṣma maṃtrarājena saṃyutam .. 15 ..
1.199.d:
स्नात्वा राजोपचारेण पुनराचम्य यत्नतः ॥
स्नानं कृत्वा ततो भीष्म मंत्रराजेन संयुतम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.199.m: Having bathed with royal offerings, and having sipped water again with care, / having then performed the bath, O Bhīṣma, accompanied by the king of mantras—

1.199.s:
harephau biṃduyuktaśca tathānyo dīrghayā saha ..
mātrayā rephasaṃyukto hakāro biṃdunā saha .. 16 ..
1.199.d:
हरेफौ बिंदुयुक्तश्च तथान्यो दीर्घया सह ॥
मात्रया रेफसंयुक्तो हकारो बिंदुना सह ॥ 16 ॥
1.199.m: ha and ra combined with a bindu, and another [ha] with a long / vowel, combined with ra, the letter ha with a bindu,

1.199.s:
sakāraḥ savisargastu maṃtrarājo'yamucyate ..
tatastu tarpayenmaṃtrānsarvāṃstāṃstu karāgrajaiḥ .. 17 ..
1.199.d:
सकारः सविसर्गस्तु मंत्रराजोऽयमुच्यते ॥
ततस्तु तर्पयेन्मंत्रान्सर्वांस्तांस्तु कराग्रजैः ॥ 17 ॥
1.199.m: and the letter sa with a visarga—this is called the king of mantras. / Then one should gratify all those mantras with the tips of the fingers:

1.199.s:
parvaṇāmūrdhvato devāḥ savyena munayastathā ..
pitaraścāpasavyena tadbījena pratarpayet.. .. 18 ..
1.199.d:
पर्वणामूर्ध्वतो देवाः सव्येन मुनयस्तथा ॥
पितरश्चापसव्येन तद्बीजेन प्रतर्पयेत्॥ ॥ 18 ॥
1.199.m: the gods above the finger-joints with the right hand, and the sages likewise; / and one should gratify the ancestors with the inverted hand using that seed-syllable.

1.199.s:
yadgītaṃ pravaraṃ loke akṣarāṇāṃ manīṣibhiḥ ..
tadbiṃdusahitaṃ proktaṃ hṛdbījaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 19 ..
1.199.d:
यद्गीतं प्रवरं लोके अक्षराणां मनीषिभिः ॥
तद्बिंदुसहितं प्रोक्तं हृद्बीजं नात्र संशयः ॥ 19 ॥
1.199.m: That which is praised by wise men as the foremost among syllables in the world, / that, accompanied by a bindu, is declared to be the heart seed-syllable, there is no doubt.

1.199.s:
kṛtvā vāmakare hastāddhyātvā prājño vidhānavit ..
evaṃ snātvā vidhānena saṃdhyāṃ vandedvidhānataḥ .. 20 ..
1.199.d:
कृत्वा वामकरे हस्ताद्ध्यात्वा प्राज्ञो विधानवित् ॥
एवं स्नात्वा विधानेन संध्यां वन्देद्विधानतः ॥ 20 ॥
1.199.m: Having placed [it] on the left hand from the hand, meditating, the wise man who knows the procedure, / having thus bathed according to rule, should worship the twilight juncture according to rule.

1.199.s:
tato vidvānkṣipetpaścādbhāskarāyodakāṃjalim ..
japecca tryakṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ vā yadicchayā .. 21 ..
1.199.d:
ततो विद्वान्क्षिपेत्पश्चाद्भास्करायोदकांजलिम् ॥
जपेच्च त्र्यक्षरं मंत्रं षण्मुखं वा यदिच्छया ॥ 21 ॥
1.199.m: Then the wise man should offer cupped hands of water to the sun, / and should mutter at will the three-syllable mantra or the six-faced [mantra].

1.199.s:
maṃtrarājeti yaḥ pūrvaṃ tavākhyāto mayā nṛpa ..
paścāttīrthe tu maṃtrāṃstu saṃhṛtya hṛdayaṃ nyaset .. 22 ..
1.199.d:
मंत्रराजेति यः पूर्वं तवाख्यातो मया नृप ॥
पश्चात्तीर्थे तु मंत्रांस्तु संहृत्य हृदयं न्यसेत् ॥ 22 ॥
1.199.m: O king, that mantra which was previously declared to you by me as the king of mantras— / withdrawing those mantras at the sacred water, he should then deposit them in the heart.

1.199.s:
maṃtrairātmānamekatra kṛtvā hyarghyaṃ pradāpayet ..
raktacandanagaṃdhaistu śucisnāto mahītale .. 23 ..
1.199.d:
मंत्रैरात्मानमेकत्र कृत्वा ह्यर्घ्यं प्रदापयेत् ॥
रक्तचन्दनगंधैस्तु शुचिस्नातो महीतले ॥ 23 ॥
1.199.m: Having united oneself by means of mantras, he should indeed offer the guest-gift; / having bathed purely on the earth with the fragrances of red sandalwood,

1.199.s:
kṛtvā maṇḍalakaṃ vittamekacitto vyavasthitaḥ ..
gṛhītvā karavīrāṇi saṃsthāpya tāmrabhājane .. 24 ..
1.199.d:
कृत्वा मण्डलकं वित्तमेकचित्तो व्यवस्थितः ॥
गृहीत्वा करवीराणि संस्थाप्य ताम्रभाजने ॥ 24 ॥
1.199.m: having drawn a mandala, with focused mind and concentrated awareness, / taking oleander blossoms and placing them in a copper vessel,

1.199.s:
tilataṃḍulasayuktaṃ kuśagandhodakena tu ..
raktacandanadhūpena yuktamarghyaṃ prasādhya tat .. 25 ..
1.199.d:
तिलतंडुलसयुक्तं कुशगन्धोदकेन तु ॥
रक्तचन्दनधूपेन युक्तमर्घ्यं प्रसाध्य तत् ॥ 25 ॥
1.199.m: joined with sesame seeds and unhusked rice grains, with water of kuśa grass and scent, / combined with red sandalwood and incense, having prepared that guest-gift,

1.199.s:
kṛtvā śirasi tatpātraṃ jānubhyāmavaniṃ gataḥ ..
pūrvamaṃtreṇa saṃyuktamarghyaṃ dadyāttu bhānave ..26..
1.199.d:
कृत्वा शिरसि तत्पात्रं जानुभ्यामवनिं गतः ॥
पूर्वमंत्रेण संयुक्तमर्घ्यं दद्यात्तु भानवे ॥26॥
1.199.m: placing that vessel upon his head, having gone to the earth on both knees, / he should offer the guest-gift to the sun, accompanied by the previous mantra.

1.199.s:
mucyate sarvapāpaistu yo hyevaṃ vinivedayet ..
yadyugādisahasreṇa vyatīpātaśatena ca .. 27 ..
1.199.d:
मुच्यते सर्वपापैस्तु यो ह्येवं विनिवेदयेत् ॥
यद्युगादिसहस्रेण व्यतीपातशतेन च ॥ 27 ॥
1.199.m: He who presents [it] in this way is freed from all sins. / Whatever [fruit is attained] by a thousand beginnings of yugas and a hundred vyatīpātas,

1.199.s:
ayanānāṃ sahasreṇa candrasya grahaṇe tathā ..
gavāṃ śatasahasreṇa yatphalaṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare ..
datte kurukulaśreṣṭha tadarghyeṇa phalaṃ labhet ..28..
1.199.d:
अयनानां सहस्रेण चन्द्रस्य ग्रहणे तथा ॥
गवां शतसहस्रेण यत्फलं ज्येष्ठपुष्करे ॥
दत्ते कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ तदर्घ्येण फलं लभेत् ॥28॥
1.199.m: by a thousand solstices, and at an eclipse of the moon, / [or] by the gift of a hundred thousand cows at Jyeṣṭhapuṣkara, O best of the Kuru lineage—that fruit he obtains through that guest-gift.

1.199.s:
dīkṣāmantravihīno'pi bhaktyā saṃvatsareṇa tu ..
phalamarghyeṇa vai vīra labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 29 ..
1.199.d:
दीक्षामन्त्रविहीनोऽपि भक्त्या संवत्सरेण तु ॥
फलमर्घ्येण वै वीर लभते नात्र संशयः ॥ 29 ॥
1.199.m: Even one devoid of initiation and mantras, through devotion over one year, / obtains the fruit through the guest-gift, O hero; there is no doubt here.

1.199.s:
yaḥ punardīkṣito vidvānvidhinārghyaṃ nivedayet ..
nāsāvutpadyate bhūmau sa layaṃ yāti bhāskare.. 30 ..
1.199.d:
यः पुनर्दीक्षितो विद्वान्विधिनार्घ्यं निवेदयेत् ॥
नासावुत्पद्यते भूमौ स लयं याति भास्करे॥ 30 ॥
1.199.m: Moreover, the wise man who is initiated and presents the guest-gift according to the rule, / is not reborn on earth; he attains dissolution in the sun.

1.199.s:
iha janmani saubhāgyamāyurāgegyasaṃpadām ..
acirādbhavate vīra sa bhāryāsukhabhājanam..31..
1.199.d:
इह जन्मनि सौभाग्यमायुरागेग्यसंपदाम् ॥
अचिराद्भवते वीर स भार्यासुखभाजनम्॥31॥
1.199.m: In this birth he attains good fortune, long life, health, and prosperity; / before long, O hero, he becomes a vessel for the happiness of a wife.

1.199.s:
eṣa snānavidhiḥ prokto mayā saṃkṣepatastava ..
hitāya mānaveṃdrāṇāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ ..32.. ..
sauradharmavarṇanam
1.199.d:
एष स्नानविधिः प्रोक्तो मया संक्षेपतस्तव ॥
हिताय मानवेंद्राणां सर्वपापप्रणाशनः ॥32॥ ॥
सौरधर्मवर्णनम्
1.199.m:
This rule of bathing has been declared in brief to you by me, / for the welfare of the lords of men, destroying all sins.
Description of the Saura duties

1.200.s:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
kathitaste snānavidhirbrahmanvai pāpahārakaḥ ..
samyagbrahmarcanavidhiṃ pūjayiṣyāmi yena vai .. 1 ..
1.200.d:
॥ भीष्म उवाच ॥ ॥
कथितस्ते स्नानविधिर्ब्रह्मन्वै पापहारकः ॥
सम्यग्ब्रह्मर्चनविधिं पूजयिष्यामि येन वै ॥ 1 ॥
1.200.m:
Bhīṣma said:
The rule of bathing has been told by you, O brāhmaṇa, which takes away sin; / [tell me] the proper rule of worshipping Brahmā, by which I may indeed worship him.

1.200.s:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
haṃta te saṃpravakṣyāmi vidhimādityapūjane ..
vivikte vijaya sthāne suprasanne suśobhane .. 2 ..
1.200.d:
॥ व्यास उवाच ॥ ॥
हंत ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि विधिमादित्यपूजने ॥
विविक्ते विजय स्थाने सुप्रसन्ने सुशोभने ॥ 2 ॥
1.200.m:
Vyāsa said:
Come, I shall declare to you the rule regarding the worship of Āditya, / in a secluded place, an auspicious spot, very pleasant and beautiful.

1.200.s:
pūjayedbhāskaraṃ mantrī saralīkṛtavigrahaḥ ..
bhadrāsanasamārūḍhaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ sādhakottamaḥ .. 3 ..
1.200.d:
पूजयेद्भास्करं मन्त्री सरलीकृतविग्रहः ॥
भद्रासनसमारूढः प्राङ्मुखः साधकोत्तमः ॥ 3 ॥
1.200.m: The practitioner of mantras should worship the sun, having straightened his body; / seated upon an auspicious seat, facing east, being the best of practitioners,

1.200.s:
astrabījena maṃtreṇa naraḥ svāṃgāni vinyaset ..
aṃguṣṭhamāditaḥ kṛtvā kaniṣṭhāntaṃ suvinyaset ..4..
1.200.d:
अस्त्रबीजेन मंत्रेण नरः स्वांगानि विन्यसेत् ॥
अंगुष्ठमादितः कृत्वा कनिष्ठान्तं सुविन्यसेत् ॥4॥
1.200.m: a man should deposit his limbs with the mantra of the weapon-seed; / starting from the thumb, he should properly deposit up to the little finger.

1.200.s:
hṛdayādīnphaḍantāṃstānvinyasetkramataḥ sadā ..
netrapāṇitale vīra nyasya arghyādi maṃtravit .. 5 ..
1.200.d:
हृदयादीन्फडन्तांस्तान्विन्यसेत्क्रमतः सदा ॥
नेत्रपाणितले वीर न्यस्य अर्घ्यादि मंत्रवित् ॥ 5 ॥
1.200.m: He should always deposit in order those beginning with the heart and ending with phaṭ; / having deposited on the eye and the palm of the hand, O hero, he who knows mantras [should offer] the guest-gift and the like.

1.200.s:
yavarge yacaturthaṃ tu karṇabiṃdusamanvitam ..
netrabījamiti proktaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..6..
1.200.d:
यवर्गे यचतुर्थं तु कर्णबिंदुसमन्वितम् ॥
नेत्रबीजमिति प्रोक्तं ज्योतीरूपं न संशयः ॥6॥
1.200.m: That which is fourth in the ya-group, joined with the ear and the drop, / is declared to be the eye-seed, having the form of light, without doubt.

1.200.s:
paścāttu tryakṣaraṃ sūryaṃ kavacaṃ vinyasedbudhaḥ ..
kathitaṃ tanmayā vīra maṃtrarājeti pṛcchataḥ .. 7 ..
1.200.d:
पश्चात्तु त्र्यक्षरं सूर्यं कवचं विन्यसेद्बुधः ॥
कथितं तन्मया वीर मंत्रराजेति पृच्छतः ॥ 7 ॥
1.200.m: Thereafter, the wise man should deposit the three-syllable solar armour; / that was declared by me, O hero, to you who asked about the king of mantras.

1.200.s:
prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kuryātprathamaṃ bījamudgiran ..
śeṣakrameṇa hutvāyaṃ viraje bhīṣmaśaktitaḥ .. 8 ..
1.200.d:
प्राणायामं ततः कुर्यात्प्रथमं बीजमुद्गिरन् ॥
शेषक्रमेण हुत्वायं विरजे भीष्मशक्तितः ॥ 8 ॥
1.200.m: Then he should perform breath control, uttering the first seed; / having offered this in the remaining order into the stainless one, O Bhīṣma, according to his ability,

1.200.s:
tribhireva tato ghorairātmaśuddhiḥ kṛtā bhavet ..
iti saṃśodhya cātmānaṃ sūryaṃ sarvāṃtikaṃ nyaset .. 9 ..
1.200.d:
त्रिभिरेव ततो घोरैरात्मशुद्धिः कृता भवेत् ॥
इति संशोध्य चात्मानं सूर्यं सर्वांतिकं न्यसेत् ॥ 9 ॥
1.200.m: then purification of oneself will be accomplished by three dread [utterances] alone. / Having thus purified oneself, he should deposit the sun on all sides.

1.200.s:
hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyasya śiraḥ śirasi vinyaset ..
ekaviṃśatimātṛkāyā akṣaraṃ yatprakīrtitam .. 10 ..
1.200.d:
हृदये हृदयं न्यस्य शिरः शिरसि विन्यसेत् ॥
एकविंशतिमातृकाया अक्षरं यत्प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 10 ॥
1.200.m: Depositing the heart on the heart, he should deposit the head on the head; / that which is proclaimed as the syllable of the twenty-first mother,

1.200.s:
hṛdbījamiti vikhyātaṃ brahmasthānamanaupamam..
śirasārkasya pūjā tu lokerkaḥ pratikathyate .. 11 ..
1.200.d:
हृद्बीजमिति विख्यातं ब्रह्मस्थानमनौपमम्॥
शिरसार्कस्य पूजा तु लोकेर्कः प्रतिकथ्यते ॥ 11 ॥
1.200.m: is celebrated as the heart-seed, the incomparable place of Brahman; / the worship of the sun on the head is described in the world as the sun.

1.200.s:
śikhāyāṃ tu śikhāṃ nyasyeccharīre kavacaṃ nyaset ..
netrayorvinyasennetraṃ karayorastrameva ca .. 12 ..
1.200.d:
शिखायां तु शिखां न्यस्येच्छरीरे कवचं न्यसेत् ॥
नेत्रयोर्विन्यसेन्नेत्रं करयोरस्त्रमेव च ॥ 12 ॥
1.200.m: He should deposit the crest on the crest, and he should deposit the armour on the body; / he should deposit the eye on both eyes, and the weapon on both hands.

1.200.s:
mahāvyāhṛtayo rājaṃstathārajvālinī śikhā ..
hakāraśca rakāraśca kukāro biṃdunā saha ..13 ..
1.200.d:
महाव्याहृतयो राजंस्तथारज्वालिनी शिखा ॥
हकारश्च रकारश्च कुकारो बिंदुना सह ॥13 ॥
1.200.m: The great utterances, O king, and also the blazing crest; / the syllable ha, the syllable ra, and the syllable ku together with the drop—

1.200.s:
eteṣāṃ samayāścaiva kavacaṃ parikathyate ..
netrayorvinyasennetraṃ karayora strameva ca .. 14 ..
1.200.d:
एतेषां समयाश्चैव कवचं परिकथ्यते ॥
नेत्रयोर्विन्यसेन्नेत्रं करयोर स्त्रमेव च ॥ 14 ॥
1.200.m: the convention of these is indeed declared to be the armour; / he should deposit the eye on both eyes, and the weapon on both hands.

1.200.s:
evamaṃgāni vinyasya nāsau kenāpi bāddhyate ..
śatravo mitratāṃ yāṃti alābhe lābhamāpnuyāt ..15..
1.200.d:
एवमंगानि विन्यस्य नासौ केनापि बाद्ध्यते ॥
शत्रवो मित्रतां यांति अलाभे लाभमाप्नुयात् ॥15॥
1.200.m: Having deposited his limbs in this manner, he is not afflicted by anyone; / his enemies become friends, and in absence of gain he obtains gain.

1.200.s:
ātmānaṃ bhāskaraṃ jñātvā yathoktaṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ ..
tatastu pūjayedbhānuṃ sthaṃḍile vidhivatpunaḥ .. 16 ..
1.200.d:
आत्मानं भास्करं ज्ञात्वा यथोक्तं तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ॥
ततस्तु पूजयेद्भानुं स्थंडिले विधिवत्पुनः ॥ 16 ॥
1.200.m: Knowing oneself to be the sun, as spoken by the seers of truth, / he should then worship the sun on a bare mound according to rule once more.

1.200.s:
kṛtvā tu dakṣiṇe pārśve divyapuṣpakaraṃḍakam ..
kṛtvā suśobhite vāme tāmrapūrṇena vāriṇā .. 17 ..
1.200.d:
कृत्वा तु दक्षिणे पार्श्वे दिव्यपुष्पकरंडकम् ॥
कृत्वा सुशोभिते वामे ताम्रपूर्णेन वारिणा ॥ 17 ॥
1.200.m: Placing a basket of divine flowers on the right side, / and placing [a vessel] filled with water in copper on the beautiful left side,

1.200.s:
astreṇa kṣālitāṃ pūrṇāṃ śeṣaṃ maṃtrairjalaistathā ..
abhimaṃtrya tataḥ sthāpya kavacenāvaguṃṭhitām .. 18 ..
1.200.d:
अस्त्रेण क्षालितां पूर्णां शेषं मंत्रैर्जलैस्तथा ॥
अभिमंत्र्य ततः स्थाप्य कवचेनावगुंठिताम् ॥ 18 ॥
1.200.m: washed with the weapon[-mantra], filled, and consecrating the rest with mantras and waters, / and then placing it, veiled with the armour[-mantra],

1.200.s:
sthaṃḍile caiva dravyāṇi pūjārthaṃ kalpitāni tu ..
sarvāṇi prokṣayedvidvānarghyapātraṃ jalena tu ..
tato maṃtraṃ japetpaścādekacittena maṃtravit ..19..
1.200.d:
स्थंडिले चैव द्रव्याणि पूजार्थं कल्पितानि तु ॥
सर्वाणि प्रोक्षयेद्विद्वानर्घ्यपात्रं जलेन तु ॥
ततो मंत्रं जपेत्पश्चादेकचित्तेन मंत्रवित् ॥19॥
1.200.m: and the substances prepared on the mound for the sake of worship— / the wise man should sprinkle all of them with water from the guest-gift vessel; / then afterwards, he who knows mantras should mutter the mantra with one-pointed mind.

1.200.s:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
purāṇasahitairmaṃtrairyo vidhiḥ kathito budhaiḥ ..20..
1.200.d:
॥ भीष्म उवाच ॥ ॥
पुराणसहितैर्मंत्रैर्यो विधिः कथितो बुधैः ॥20॥
1.200.m:
Bhīṣma said:
The rule that is declared by the wise along with the mantras of the Purāṇas—

1.200.s:
sa mayā viditaḥ kṛtsnaḥ kathito naikaśo dvijaiḥ ..
vedoktairvividhairmaṃtrairyathā saṃpūjyate raviḥ ..21 ..
1.200.d:
स मया विदितः कृत्स्नः कथितो नैकशो द्विजैः ॥
वेदोक्तैर्विविधैर्मंत्रैर्यथा संपूज्यते रविः ॥21 ॥
1.200.m: that is completely known to me, told repeatedly by the twice-born. / How the sun is worshipped with various mantras spoken in the Vedas,

1.200.s:
tathā me brūhi sakalaṃ vaidikaṃ vidhisattamam .. 22 ..
sūryamaṇḍaladevatārcanavidhivarṇanam
1.200.d:
तथा मे ब्रूहि सकलं वैदिकं विधिसत्तमम् ॥ 22 ॥
सूर्यमण्डलदेवतार्चनविधिवर्णनम्
1.200.m:
tell me all of that, the supreme Vedic rule.
Description of the rule of worship of the deities of the solar disc

1.201.s:
.. vyāsa uvāca ..
atha tvāṃ kathayiṣyehaṃ saṃvādaṃ dharmavarddhanam ..
surajyeṣṭhasya devasya keśavasya ca bhārata .. 1 ..
1.201.d:
॥ व्यास उवाच ॥
अथ त्वां कथयिष्येहं संवादं धर्मवर्द्धनम् ॥
सुरज्येष्ठस्य देवस्य केशवस्य च भारत ॥ 1 ॥
1.201.m:
Vyāsa said:
Now I shall tell you the dialogue that increases righteousness, / between the eldest of the gods and Keśava, O descendant of Bharata.

1.201.s:
manovatyāṃ surajyeṣṭhaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ caturmukham..
praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuridaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 2 ..
1.201.d:
मनोवत्यां सुरज्येष्ठं सुखासीनं चतुर्मुखम्॥
प्रणम्य शिरसा विष्णुरिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ 2 ॥
1.201.m: Bowing his head to the four-faced eldest of the gods who was seated comfortably in Manovatī, / Viṣṇu spoke these words:

1.201.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
bhagavandevadeveśa surajyeṣṭha caturmukha ..
ārādhanavidhiṃ brūhi bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ .. 3 ..
1.201.d:
॥ विष्णुरुवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्देवदेवेश सुरज्येष्ठ चतुर्मुख ॥
आराधनविधिं ब्रूहि भास्करस्य महात्मनः ॥ 3 ॥
1.201.m:
Viṣṇu said:
O blessed one, ruler of the gods of gods, eldest of the gods, four-faced one, / tell me the rule of propitiation of the noble sun.

1.201.s:
kathamārādhayedbhānuṃ maṃḍalasthaṃ divaspatim ..
brūhi me'tra gaṇaṃ devaṃ yenāhaṃ pūjaye vibhum .. 4 ..
1.201.d:
कथमाराधयेद्भानुं मंडलस्थं दिवस्पतिम् ॥
ब्रूहि मेऽत्र गणं देवं येनाहं पूजये विभुम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.201.m: How should one propitiate the sun, the lord of day residing in his orb? / Tell me here the retinue, O god, by which I may worship the omnipresent lord.

1.201.s:
sādhusādhu mahābāho sādhu pṛṣṭo' smi bhūdhara ..
śṛṇu caikamanā deva bhāskarārādhane vidhim ..5..
1.201.d:
साधुसाधु महाबाहो साधु पृष्टो' स्मि भूधर ॥
शृणु चैकमना देव भास्कराराधने विधिम् ॥5॥
1.201.m:
[Brahmā said:]
Well done, well done, O mighty-armed one! Well asked am I, O supporter of the earth! / Listen with one-pointed mind, O god, to the rule for propitiating the sun.

1.201.s:
khaṣolkaṃ nirmalaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā vibhāvasum ..
pūrve madhye tathāgneyyāṃ virūpākṣe prabhaṃ jane .. 6 ..
1.201.d:
खषोल्कं निर्मलं देवं पूजयित्वा विभावसुम् ॥
पूर्वे मध्ये तथाग्नेय्यां विरूपाक्षे प्रभं जने ॥ 6 ॥
1.201.m: Having worshipped the spotless god Khaṣolka, who is the sun, / in the east, in the centre, likewise in the south-east, in Virūpākṣa, and in Prabhañjana,

1.201.s:
krameṇa yāvadīśānīṃ hṛdi bījena vinyaset ..
khaṣolkāsanametattu vinyastaṃ mānavottamaiḥ .. 7..
1.201.d:
क्रमेण यावदीशानीं हृदि बीजेन विन्यसेत् ॥
खषोल्कासनमेतत्तु विन्यस्तं मानवोत्तमैः ॥ 7॥
1.201.m: in order up to the north-east, he should deposit [them] in the heart with the seed; / this seat of Khaṣolka is deposited by the best of men.

1.201.s:
tatastasyopariṣṭāttu hṛdayena tu kaṃcu kam ..
saptāvaraṇasaṃyuktamaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam .. 8 ..
1.201.d:
ततस्तस्योपरिष्टात्तु हृदयेन तु कंचु कम् ॥
सप्तावरणसंयुक्तमष्टपत्रं सकर्णिकम् ॥ 8 ॥
1.201.m: Then, above it, with the heart-[mantra], [he should visualize] the lotus / endowed with seven coverings, eight petals, and a pericarp,

1.201.s:
kesarālaṃbadevatvaṃ paṃcavarṇaṃ mahādbhutam ..
parīkṣābhūmividhivacchāstroktavidhinā kṛtam .. 9 ..
1.201.d:
केसरालंबदेवत्वं पंचवर्णं महाद्भुतम् ॥
परीक्षाभूमिविधिवच्छास्त्रोक्तविधिना कृतम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.201.m: possessing divinity resting on the filaments, five-colored, very wonderful, / constructed according to the rite for testing ground, by the method enjoined in scripture.

1.201.s:
dīptādi pūrvādārabhya yāvadīśānagocaram ..
nyasecchaktyaṣṭakaṃ maṃtrī madhyataḥ sarvatomukhīm .. 1.201.10 ..
1.201.d:
दीप्तादि पूर्वादारभ्य यावदीशानगोचरम् ॥
न्यसेच्छक्त्यष्टकं मंत्री मध्यतः सर्वतोमुखीम् ॥ 1.201.10 ॥
1.201.m: Beginning from the east and proceeding to the northeast quarter, / the mantra-reciter should deposit the group of eight powers, [and] in the center Sarvatomukhī:

1.201.s:
dīptā sūkṣmā jayā bhadrā vibhūtirvimalā tathā ..
amoghā vidyutā caiva navamī sarvatomukhī .. 11 ..
1.201.d:
दीप्ता सूक्ष्मा जया भद्रा विभूतिर्विमला तथा ॥
अमोघा विद्युता चैव नवमी सर्वतोमुखी ॥ 11 ॥
1.201.m: Dīptā, Sūkṣmā, Jayā, Bhadrā, Vibhūti, as well as Vimalā, / Amoghā, and Vidyutā, and the ninth is Sarvatomukhī.

1.201.s:
tata āvāhayedbhānuṃ sthāpayetkarṇikopari..
upasthānaṃ tu vai kṛtvā maṃtreṇānena suvrata .. 12 ..
1.201.d:
तत आवाहयेद्भानुं स्थापयेत्कर्णिकोपरि॥
उपस्थानं तु वै कृत्वा मंत्रेणानेन सुव्रत ॥ 12 ॥
1.201.m: Then he should invoke the Sun and install him upon the pericarp; / and having performed homage with this mantra, O observer of good vows:

1.201.s:
udutyaṃ jātavedasamiti maṃtraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
agniṃ dūtena maṃtreṇa anena viśvasuvrata ..13..
1.201.d:
उदुत्यं जातवेदसमिति मंत्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
अग्निं दूतेन मंत्रेण अनेन विश्वसुव्रत ॥13॥
1.201.m: "ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam" is proclaimed as the mantra. / With the mantra "agniṃ dūtam", O observer of vows for the world,

1.201.s:
ākṛṣṇena rajasā maṃtreṇānena cārcayet ..
haṃsaḥśuciṣaditi ca maṃtreṇārkaṃ prapūjayet .. 14 ..
1.201.d:
आकृष्णेन रजसा मंत्रेणानेन चार्चयेत् ॥
हंसःशुचिषदिति च मंत्रेणार्कं प्रपूजयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
1.201.m: and with this mantra, "ākṛṣṇena rajasā", he should worship [him]; / and with the mantra "haṃsaḥ śuciṣat" he should worship the Sun.

1.201.s:
apaptetārakaṃ devīdīptānena prapūjayet ..
adṛśramasyaketavaḥ sūkṣmāṃ devīṃ samarcayet .. 15..
1.201.d:
अपप्तेतारकं देवीदीप्तानेन प्रपूजयेत् ॥
अदृश्रमस्यकेतवः सूक्ष्मां देवीं समर्चयेत् ॥ 15॥
1.201.m: With "apaptat tārakaḥ" he should worship the goddess Dīptā; / with "adṛśram asya ketavaḥ" he should worship the goddess Sūkṣmā;

1.201.s:
taraṇirviśvadarśeti anena satataṃ jayam ..
pratyaṅdevānāṃ viśeti bhadrāṃ devīṃ samarcayet .. 16 ..
1.201.d:
तरणिर्विश्वदर्शेति अनेन सततं जयम् ॥
प्रत्यङ्देवानां विशेति भद्रां देवीं समर्चयेत् ॥ 16 ॥
1.201.m: with "taraṇir viśvadarśataḥ" [he should worship] Jayā perpetually; / with "pratyaṅ devānāṃ viśaḥ" he should worship the goddess Bhadrā;

1.201.s:
vibhūtimarcayennityaṃ yenāpāvakacakṣasā ..
vidyāmeṣīti maṃtreṇa hyanena vimalāṃ sadā .. 17 ..
1.201.d:
विभूतिमर्चयेन्नित्यं येनापावकचक्षसा ॥
विद्यामेषीति मंत्रेण ह्यनेन विमलां सदा ॥ 17 ॥
1.201.m: with "yena pāvaka cakṣasā" he should perpetually worship Vibhūti; / and with this mantra, "vidyām eṣi", always [worship] Vimalā;

1.201.s:
amoghāṃ pūjayennityaṃ maṃtreṇānena suvrata..
navamīṃ pūjayeddevīṃ satataṃ sarvatomukhīm .. 18 ..
1.201.d:
अमोघां पूजयेन्नित्यं मंत्रेणानेन सुव्रत॥
नवमीं पूजयेद्देवीं सततं सर्वतोमुखीम् ॥ 18 ॥
1.201.m: he should perpetually worship Amoghā with this mantra, O observer of good vows; / [and] he should always worship the ninth goddess, Sarvatomukhī.

1.201.s:
maṃtreṇānena kṛṣṇasya udvayaṃtamitīha ca ..
udyannadyamitrahomaṃ prathamamakṣaraṃ vrajet.. 19 ..
1.201.d:
मंत्रेणानेन कृष्णस्य उद्वयंतमितीह च ॥
उद्यन्नद्यमित्रहोमं प्रथममक्षरं व्रजेत्॥ 19 ॥
1.201.m: With this mantra of Kṛṣṇa, "ud vayaṃ tamasas pari"; / [and] "udyann adya mitramahaḥ", he should proceed to the first syllable.

1.201.s:
dvitīyaṃ pūjayetkṛṣṇaṃ śukleṣu harimāhave ..
udagādayamādityo anenāpi tṛtīyakam .. 1.201.20 ..
1.201.d:
द्वितीयं पूजयेत्कृष्णं शुक्लेषु हरिमाहवे ॥
उदगादयमादित्यो अनेनापि तृतीयकम् ॥ 1.201.20 ॥
1.201.m: He should worship the second, the dark Hari among the white, in the battle; / with "ud agād ayam ādityaḥ" [he should worship] the third also;

1.201.s:
tatsaviturvareṇyeti caturthaṃ parikīrtitam ..
mahitomahitoyeti paṃcarcaṃ parikīrtayet .. 21 ..
1.201.d:
तत्सवितुर्वरेण्येति चतुर्थं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
महितोमहितोयेति पंचर्चं परिकीर्तयेत् ॥ 21 ॥
1.201.m: "tat savitur vareṇyam" is proclaimed as the fourth; / he should recite the five-verse hymn, "mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca naḥ";

1.201.s:
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatā ṣaṣṭhaṃ bījaṃ prakīrtitam ..
savitā paścātātpurastātsaptamaṃ devasattama .. 22 ..
1.201.d:
हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तता षष्ठं बीजं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
सविता पश्चातात्पुरस्तात्सप्तमं देवसत्तम ॥ 22 ॥
1.201.m: "hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre" is proclaimed as the sixth seed-[mantra]; / "savitā paścāt savitā purastāt" is the seventh, O best of gods.

1.201.s:
evaṃ bījāni vinyasya ādityaṃ sthāpayeddvijaḥ ..
ādityaṃ sthāpayeddhyāne sarveṣāṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ .. 23 ..
1.201.d:
एवं बीजानि विन्यस्य आदित्यं स्थापयेद्द्विजः ॥
आदित्यं स्थापयेद्ध्याने सर्वेषां पूजयेद्बुधः ॥ 23 ॥
1.201.m: Having thus deposited the seed-mantras, the twice-born should install Āditya; / the wise man should establish Āditya in meditation and worship [him] before all;

1.201.s:
bāhyato devaśārdūla indrādīnāṃ samaṃtataḥ..
raktavarṇaṃ mahātejaṃ sitapadmopari sthitam..24..
1.201.d:
बाह्यतो देवशार्दूल इन्द्रादीनां समंततः॥
रक्तवर्णं महातेजं सितपद्मोपरि स्थितम्॥24॥
1.201.m: on the outside, O tiger among gods, [the deities] headed by Indra all around: / red-colored, of great splendor, seated upon a white lotus,

1.201.s:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam..
dvibhujaṃ caikacakraṃ ca saumyaṃ padmadhanuṣkaram..25..
1.201.d:
सर्वलक्षणसंयुक्तं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्॥
द्विभुजं चैकचक्रं च सौम्यं पद्मधनुष्करम्॥25॥
1.201.m: endowed with all auspicious marks, adorned with all ornaments, / two-armed and one-wheeled, gentle, with lotus and bow in hand,

1.201.s:
vartulaṃ tena biṃbena madhyasthamatitejasam..
ādityasya tvidaṃ rūpaṃ sarvalokeṣu pūjitam..26..
1.201.d:
वर्तुलं तेन बिंबेन मध्यस्थमतितेजसम्॥
आदित्यस्य त्विदं रूपं सर्वलोकेषु पूजितम्॥26॥
1.201.m: standing in the middle with that circular orb, exceeding in radiance. / This form of Āditya is worshipped in all the worlds;

1.201.s:
dhyātvā saṃpūjayennityaṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ maṃḍalāśritam..27.. ..
ādityapūjāvidhivarṇanam
1.201.d:
ध्यात्वा संपूजयेन्नित्यं स्थंडिलं मंडलाश्रितम्॥27॥ ॥
आदित्यपूजाविधिवर्णनम्
1.201.m:
having meditated [on him], he should constantly worship him on the altar resting on the diagram.
Description of the Rite of Worshipping Āditya

1.202.s:
viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
maṇḍalasthaṃ suraśreṣṭha vidhinā yena bhāskaram ..
pūjayenmānavo bhaktyā sa vidhiḥ kathyatāṃ mama .. 1 ..
1.202.d:
विष्णुरुवाच ॥ ॥
मण्डलस्थं सुरश्रेष्ठ विधिना येन भास्करम् ॥
पूजयेन्मानवो भक्त्या स विधिः कथ्यतां मम ॥ 1 ॥
1.202.m: Viṣṇu said: / O best of gods, tell me that rite by which rite / a mortal may worship Bhāskara situated in the maṇḍala with devotion.

1.202.s:
pūjayedvidhinā yena bhāskaraṃ padmasaṃbhavam ..
mūrtisthaṃ sarvagaṃ devaṃ pūjitaṃ sasurāsuraiḥ ..2..
1.202.d:
पूजयेद्विधिना येन भास्करं पद्मसंभवम् ॥
मूर्तिस्थं सर्वगं देवं पूजितं ससुरासुरैः ॥2॥
1.202.m: By which rite should one worship Bhāskara, who arose from a lotus, / the omnipresent god dwelling in an image, worshipped by gods and asuras together?

1.202.s:
.. brahmovāca ..
sādhu kṛṣṇa mahābāho sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi suvrata ..
śṛṇu caikamanāḥ pūrvaṃ mūrtisthaṃ yena pūjayet .. 3 ..
1.202.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
साधु कृष्ण महाबाहो साधु पृष्टोऽस्मि सुव्रत ॥
शृणु चैकमनाः पूर्वं मूर्तिस्थं येन पूजयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
1.202.m: Brahmā said: / Well said, O long-armed Kṛṣṇa, well asked of me, O observer of good vows! / Listen with single-pointed mind how one should previously worship [him] dwelling in an image.

1.202.s:
iṣe tveti ca mantreṇa uttamāṃgaṃ sadārcayet ..
agnimīḻeti mantreṇa pūjayeddakṣiṇe kare ..4..
1.202.d:
इषे त्वेति च मन्त्रेण उत्तमांगं सदार्चयेत् ॥
अग्निमीḻएति मन्त्रेण पूजयेद्दक्षिणे करे ॥4॥
1.202.m: With the mantra "iṣe tvorje tvā" he should constantly worship the head; / with the mantra "agnim īḷe purohitam" he should worship the right hand;

1.202.s:
agna āyāhi mantreṇa pādau devasya pūjayet ..
ājighreti ca maṃtreṇa pūjayetpuṣpamālayā ..5..
1.202.d:
अग्न आयाहि मन्त्रेण पादौ देवस्य पूजयेत् ॥
आजिघ्रेति च मंत्रेण पूजयेत्पुष्पमालया ॥5॥
1.202.m: with the mantra "agna ā yāhi vītaye" he should worship the two feet of the god; / with the mantra "ājighra kalaśam" he should worship with a garland of flowers;

1.202.s:
yogayogati maṃtreṇa muktapuṣpāṃjaliṃ kṣipet ..
samudraṃ gaccha yatproktamanena snāpayedravim .. 6 ..
1.202.d:
योगयोगति मंत्रेण मुक्तपुष्पांजलिं क्षिपेत् ॥
समुद्रं गच्छ यत्प्रोक्तमनेन स्नापयेद्रविम् ॥ 6 ॥
1.202.m: with the mantra "yoge yoge" he should throw an open handful of flowers; / with that which is proclaimed as "samudraṃ gaccha svāhā", he should bathe the Sun;

1.202.s:
imaṃ me gaṃgeti yatproktamanenāpi ca bhūdhara ..
samudrajyeti mantreṇa kaṣāyaiḥ parirūpayet.. 7 ..
1.202.d:
इमं मे गंगेति यत्प्रोक्तमनेनापि च भूधर ॥
समुद्रज्येति मन्त्रेण कषायैः परिरूपयेत्॥ 7 ॥
1.202.m: and also with that which is proclaimed as "imaṃ me gaṅge", O supporter of the earth; / with the mantra "samudrajyeṣṭhāḥ" he should wash [him] with astringent decoctions.

1.202.s:
snāpayetpayasā kṛṣṇa āpyāyasveti mantrataḥ ..
dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhnā snāpayeddadhivadravim .. 8 ..
1.202.d:
स्नापयेत्पयसा कृष्ण आप्यायस्वेति मन्त्रतः ॥
दधिक्राव्णेति वै दध्ना स्नापयेद्दधिवद्रविम् ॥ 8 ॥
1.202.m: He should bathe [him] with milk, O Kṛṣṇa, by the mantra "āpyāyasva"; / with curd, by "dadhikrāvṇo", he should bathe the Sun like curd.

1.202.s:
tejo'si śukramiti ca ghṛtena snapanaṃ param..
yā auṣadhīti maṃtreṇa snānamoṣadhibhiḥ smṛtam .. 9 ..
1.202.d:
तेजोऽसि शुक्रमिति च घृतेन स्नपनं परम्॥
या औषधीति मंत्रेण स्नानमोषधिभिः स्मृतम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.202.m: And with "tejo 'si śukram" the bathing with clarified butter is the highest; / with the mantra "yā oṣadhīḥ" the bath with herbs is taught.

1.202.s:
udvartayettato dvipadābhiḥ surādhipa ..
mānastoketi mantreṇa yugapatsnānamācaret..10..
1.202.d:
उद्वर्तयेत्ततो द्विपदाभिः सुराधिप ॥
मानस्तोकेति मन्त्रेण युगपत्स्नानमाचरेत्॥10॥
1.202.m: Then he should rub [him] with the two-footed verses, O lord of gods; / with the mantra "mā nas toke" he should perform the simultaneous bath.

1.202.s:
viṣṇorarāṭamantreṇa snāpayedgandhavāriṇā..
sauvarṇena tu maṃtreṇa arghyaṃ pādyaṃ nivedayet..11..
1.202.d:
विष्णोरराटमन्त्रेण स्नापयेद्गन्धवारिणा॥
सौवर्णेन तु मंत्रेण अर्घ्यं पाद्यं निवेदयेत्॥11॥
1.202.m: With the mantra "viṣṇor arāṭam asi" he should bathe him with fragrant water; / with the golden mantra he should offer the guest-offering and the water for washing the feet.

1.202.s:
idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame maṃtreṇārghyaṃ pradāpayet..
vedo'sīti hi maṃtreṇa upavītaṃ pradāpayet..12..
1.202.d:
इदं विष्णुर्विचक्रमे मंत्रेणार्घ्यं प्रदापयेत्॥
वेदोऽसीति हि मंत्रेण उपवीतं प्रदापयेत्॥12॥
1.202.m: With the mantra "idaṃ viṣṇur vi cakrame" he should present the guest-offering; / with the mantra "vedo 'si" indeed he should present the sacred thread.

1.202.s:
bṛhaspateti mantreṇa dadyādvastrāṇi bhānave..
yena śriyaṃ prakurvāṇāṃ puṣpamālāṃ prayojayet..13..
1.202.d:
बृहस्पतेति मन्त्रेण दद्याद्वस्त्राणि भानवे॥
येन श्रियं प्रकुर्वाणां पुष्पमालां प्रयोजयेत्॥13॥
1.202.m: With the mantra "bṛhaspate" he should give garments to the Sun; / with "yena śriyam" he should apply a blooming garland of flowers.

1.202.s:
dhūrasīti ca mantreṇa dhūpaṃ dadyātsaguggulam..
samiddhoṃ'janamaṃtreṇa aṃjanaṃ tu prayacchati..14..
1.202.d:
धूरसीति च मन्त्रेण धूपं दद्यात्सगुग्गुलम्॥
समिद्धोंऽजनमंत्रेण अंजनं तु प्रयच्छति॥14॥
1.202.m: With the mantra "dhūr asi" he should give incense accompanied with bdellium; / with the mantra "samiddho añjan" he presents collyrium.

1.202.s:
yuñjānīti ca maṃtreṇa bhānuṃ rocanayārcayet ..
āraktakaṃ ca vai kuryāddīrghāyuṣṭvāya vai budhaḥ .. 15 ..
1.202.d:
युञ्जानीति च मंत्रेण भानुं रोचनयार्चयेत् ॥
आरक्तकं च वै कुर्याद्दीर्घायुष्ट्वाय वै बुधः ॥ 15 ॥
1.202.m: With the mantra "yuñjānāḥ" he should worship the Sun with yellow orpiment; / and the wise man should apply red paste for longevity.

1.202.s:
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo raviṃ sarasi pūjayet ..
saṃbhāvayeti maṃtreṇa padmanetre parāmṛśet .. 16 ..
1.202.d:
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषो रविं सरसि पूजयेत् ॥
संभावयेति मंत्रेण पद्मनेत्रे परामृशेत् ॥ 16 ॥
1.202.m: With "sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ" he should worship the Sun in the pool; / with the mantra "saṃbhāvaya" he should touch his two lotus eyes;

1.202.s:
viśvataścakṣurityevaṃ bhānordehaṃ samālabhet ..
śrīśca te lakṣmīśceti maṃtreṇānena pūjayet .. 17 ..
bhāskarārādhanavidhivarṇanam
1.202.d:
विश्वतश्चक्षुरित्येवं भानोर्देहं समालभेत् ॥
श्रीश्च ते लक्ष्मीश्चेति मंत्रेणानेन पूजयेत् ॥ 17 ॥
भास्कराराधनविधिवर्णनम्
1.202.m:
with "viśvataścakṣuḥ" he should anoint the body of the Sun; / and with this mantra, "śrīś ca te lakṣmīś ca", he should worship him.
Description of the Rite of Adoration of Bhāskara

1.203.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca ..
vyomapūjāvidhiṃ brūhi samāsāccaturānana ..
aṣṭaśṛṃgaṃ kathaṃ vyoma pūjayedbhāskarasya tu .. 1 ..
1.203.d:
॥ विष्णुरुवाच ॥
व्योमपूजाविधिं ब्रूहि समासाच्चतुरानन ॥
अष्टशृंगं कथं व्योम पूजयेद्भास्करस्य तु ॥ 1 ॥
1.203.m: Viṣṇu said: / Tell succinctly the rite of worshipping the vault, O four-faced one; / how should one worship the eight-peaked vault of Bhāskara?

1.203.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
vyomapūjāvidhiṃ kṛṣṇa nibodha gadato mama ..
aṣṭaśṛṃgaṃ yathā vyoma pūjayaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ .. 2 ..
1.203.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥ ॥
व्योमपूजाविधिं कृष्ण निबोध गदतो मम ॥
अष्टशृंगं यथा व्योम पूजयंति मनीषिणः ॥ 2 ॥
1.203.m: Brahmā said: / Learn from me speaking, O Kṛṣṇa, the rite of worshipping the vault, / how wise men worship the eight-peaked vault.

1.203.s:
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kṛtvā cāśmamayaṃ tathā ..
aṣṭaśṛṃgaṃ mahābāho anena vidhinārcayet .. 3 ..
1.203.d:
सौवर्णं राजतं ताम्रं कृत्वा चाश्ममयं तथा ॥
अष्टशृंगं महाबाहो अनेन विधिनार्चयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
1.203.m: Having made [it] of gold, of silver, of copper, and likewise of stone, / the eight-peaked [altar], O long-armed one, one should worship by this rite.

1.203.s:
prathamaṃ pūjayedbhānuṃ madhye maṃtreṇa suvrata ..
mahiṣā vo mahāyeti nānāpuṣpakadaṃbakaiḥ .. 4 ..
1.203.d:
प्रथमं पूजयेद्भानुं मध्ये मंत्रेण सुव्रत ॥
महिषा वो महायेति नानापुष्पकदंबकैः ॥ 4 ॥
1.203.m: First he should worship the Sun in the center with the mantra, O observer of good vows, / "mahiṣo vo mahāyate", with various clusters of flowers.

1.203.s:
trātāramiṃdraṃ maṃtreṇa sarvaśṛṃgaṃ sadārcayet ..
udīratāmavara ityatha vānena pūjayet .. 5 ..
1.203.d:
त्रातारमिंद्रं मंत्रेण सर्वशृंगं सदार्चयेत् ॥
उदीरतामवर इत्यथ वानेन पूजयेत् ॥ 5 ॥
1.203.m: With the mantra "trātāram indram" he should constantly worship all the peaks; / or alternatively, with "ud īratām avare", he should worship with this.

1.203.s:
āyaṃ gauriti mantreṇa nairṛ(kṛ)taṃ śṛṃgamarcayet ..
rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinaṃ vā pūjayedasurāṃtakam .. 6 ..
1.203.d:
आयं गौरिति मन्त्रेण नैरृ(कृ)तं शृंगमर्चयेत् ॥
रक्षोहणं वाजिनं वा पूजयेदसुरांतकम् ॥ 6 ॥
1.203.m: With the mantra “āyaṃ gauḥ,” one should worship the southwestern peak; / or one should worship the slayer of demons with “rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinaṃ.”

1.203.s:
indrasomāṃtapataye hyatha vānena pūjayet ..
abhitvā śūra no numa aiśānaṃ śṛṃgamarcayet .. 7 ..
1.203.d:
इन्द्रसोमांतपतये ह्यथ वानेन पूजयेत् ॥
अभित्वा शूर नो नुम ऐशानं शृंगमर्चयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
1.203.m: Or else with “indrasomāntapataye” one should worship him; / with “abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ,” one should worship the northeastern peak.

1.203.s:
evaṃ bhānuṃ ca paritaḥ pūjayaṃti sadācyuta ..
yenedaṃ bhūtamiti vai atha vānena pūjayeta .. 8 ..
1.203.d:
एवं भानुं च परितः पूजयंति सदाच्युत ॥
येनेदं भूतमिति वै अथ वानेन पूजयेत ॥ 8 ॥
1.203.m: Thus they always worship the sun all around, O Acyuta; / or else one should worship him with “yenedaṃ bhūtam.”

1.203.s:
namo'stu sarvapāpebhyo vyomapīṭhaṃ sadārcayet ..
te narāḥ satataṃ kāmānprāpnuvaṃti na saṃśayaḥ .. 9 ..
1.203.d:
नमोऽस्तु सर्वपापेभ्यो व्योमपीठं सदार्चयेत् ॥
ते नराः सततं कामान्प्राप्नुवंति न संशयः ॥ 9 ॥
1.203.m: Saying “Obeisance unto all evils,” one should always worship the pedestal of space; / those men constantly attain their desires, there is no doubt.

1.203.s:
tvameko rudrāṇāṃ vasūnāṃ pūrvāhṇe tena pūjayet ..
tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ haṃsaḥ śuciṣaditi vai aparāhne sadārcayet .. 10 ..
1.203.d:
त्वमेको रुद्राणां वसूनां पूर्वाह्णे तेन पूजयेत् ॥
तद्विष्णोः परमं पदं हंसः शुचिषदिति वै अपराह्ने सदार्चयेत् ॥ 10 ॥
1.203.m: In the morning one should worship with “tvameko rudrāṇāṃ vasūnām”; / with “tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ” and “haṃsaḥ śuciṣat,” one should always worship in the afternoon.

1.203.s:
evaṃ bhānuṃ grahaiḥ sārdhaṃ pūjayaṃti sadaspate ..
te sarvānvividhānkāmānprāpnuvaṃti na saṃśayaḥ .. 11 ..
1.203.d:
एवं भानुं ग्रहैः सार्धं पूजयंति सदस्पते ॥
ते सर्वान्विविधान्कामान्प्राप्नुवंति न संशयः ॥ 11 ॥
1.203.m: Thus they worship the sun together with the planets, O lord of the assembly; / they obtain all their various desires, there is no doubt.

1.203.s:
vimale vāsasī dattvā gurave sapavitrake ..
upānahau tathā kṛṣṇa sauvarṇamaṃgulīyakam .. 12 ..
1.203.d:
विमले वाससी दत्त्वा गुरवे सपवित्रके ॥
उपानहौ तथा कृष्ण सौवर्णमंगुलीयकम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.203.m: Having given two spotless garments along with purifying darbha rings to the preceptor, / as well as sandals, O Kṛṣṇa, and a golden ring,

1.203.s:
gandhapuṣpāṇi citrāṇi bhakṣyabhojyānyanekaśaḥ ..
anena vidhinā yastu sopavāsorcayedravim ..
bahuputro bahudhanaḥ sa naro bhavyavānbhavet ..13..
1.203.d:
गन्धपुष्पाणि चित्राणि भक्ष्यभोज्यान्यनेकशः ॥
अनेन विधिना यस्तु सोपवासोर्चयेद्रविम् ॥
बहुपुत्रो बहुधनः स नरो भव्यवान्भवेत् ॥13॥
1.203.m: and various perfumes and flowers, and numerous snacks and solid foods, / that man who, fasting, worships the sun according to this rule / shall have many sons, much wealth, and become prosperous.

1.203.s:
uttare cāyane yastu sopavāsorcayedravim ..
sośvamedhaphalaṃ viṃdyādbahuputraśca jāyate .. 14 ..
1.203.d:
उत्तरे चायने यस्तु सोपवासोर्चयेद्रविम् ॥
सोश्वमेधफलं विंद्याद्बहुपुत्रश्च जायते ॥ 14 ॥
1.203.m: And he who, fasting, worships the sun at the northern solstice / obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice and is born with many sons.

1.203.s:
kṛtvopavāsaṃ viṣuve yastu pūjayate ravim ..
bahuputro bahudhano kīrtimāṃścāpi jāyate .. 15 ..
1.203.d:
कृत्वोपवासं विषुवे यस्तु पूजयते रविम् ॥
बहुपुत्रो बहुधनो कीर्तिमांश्चापि जायते ॥ 15 ॥
1.203.m: He who, having fasted at the equinox, worships the sun / is born with many sons, much wealth, and illustrious.

1.203.s:
kṛtvopavāsaṃ grahaṇe vidhivaccaṃdrasūryayoḥ ..
pūjayedbhāskaraṃ bhaktyā brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 16 ..
1.203.d:
कृत्वोपवासं ग्रहणे विधिवच्चंद्रसूर्ययोः ॥
पूजयेद्भास्करं भक्त्या ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति ॥ 16 ॥
1.203.m: Having fasted at an eclipse of the moon or sun according to rule, / he who worships the sun with devotion goes to the world of Brahmā.

1.203.s:
iti te kathito viṣṇo bhāskarārādhane vidhiḥ ..
yaṃ śrutvā puruṣo bhaktyā mama loke mahīyate .. 17 ..
1.203.d:
इति ते कथितो विष्णो भास्कराराधने विधिः ॥
यं श्रुत्वा पुरुषो भक्त्या मम लोके महीयते ॥ 17 ॥
1.203.m: Thus has the rule for worshipping the sun been told to you, O Viṣṇu; / having heard it with devotion, a person is glorified in my world.

1.203.s:
punaretya mahīṃ kṛṣṇa rājā bhavati bhūtale ..
bahu putro bahudhanaḥ samareṣvaparājitaḥ .. 18 ..
vyomārcanavidhivarṇanam
1.203.d:
पुनरेत्य महीं कृष्ण राजा भवति भूतले ॥
बहु पुत्रो बहुधनः समरेष्वपराजितः ॥ 18 ॥
व्योमार्चनविधिवर्णनम्
1.203.m:
Returning to earth, O Kṛṣṇa, he becomes a king upon the terrestrial plane, / with many sons, much wealth, and undefeated in battles.
Description of the Rite of Worshipping the Sky

1.204.s:
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ paramapūjitam ..
ratnavyomapratiṣṭhāyāṃ yathā bhānuṃ prapūjayet .. 1 ..
1.204.d:
॥ सुमन्तुरुवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि विधिं परमपूजितम् ॥
रत्नव्योमप्रतिष्ठायां यथा भानुं प्रपूजयेत् ॥ 1 ॥
1.204.m: Sumantu said: / Henceforth I shall declare the supreme, revered rite / by which one should worship the sun upon the consecration of a jewel-sky.

1.204.s:
arcayitvā tu prakṛtiṃ gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairvibho ..
sahodakenāṃjalinā sahapuṣpākṣatena vā .. 2 ..
1.204.d:
अर्चयित्वा तु प्रकृतिं गंधपुष्पाक्षतैर्विभो ॥
सहोदकेनांजलिना सहपुष्पाक्षतेन वा ॥ 2 ॥
1.204.m: Having worshipped the pedestal with perfumes, flowers, and unbroken grains, O lord, / with folded hands holding water, or holding flowers and unbroken grains,

1.204.s:
āvāhayenmahādevaṃ khaṣolkaṃ bhāskaraṃ vibhum ..
mantreṇa kuruśārdūla pratyakṣakiraṇāya vai .. 3 ..
1.204.d:
आवाहयेन्महादेवं खषोल्कं भास्करं विभुम् ॥
मन्त्रेण कुरुशार्दूल प्रत्यक्षकिरणाय वै ॥ 3 ॥
1.204.m: one should invoke the great god, Khaṣolka, the all-pervading sun, / with the mantra, O tiger of the Kurus, for him whose rays are manifest:

1.204.s: oṃ khaṣolkamāvāhayāmi oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaroṃ ādityārādhane mantraḥ .. 4 ..
1.204.d: ओं खषोल्कमावाहयामि ओं भूर्भुवः स्वरों आदित्याराधने मन्त्रः ॥ 4 ॥
1.204.m: “Oṃ, I invoke Khaṣolka; oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ oṃ.” This is the mantra in the worship of Āditya.

1.204.s:
abhimantrya bhuve mātraṃ sāvitryā ca ṛcā vibho ..
āpo hiṣṭheti yā proktā vṛthā sūryasya sarvadā .. 5 ..
1.204.d:
अभिमन्त्र्य भुवे मात्रं सावित्र्या च ऋचा विभो ॥
आपो हिष्ठेति या प्रोक्ता वृथा सूर्यस्य सर्वदा ॥ 5 ॥
1.204.m: Having consecrated the earth-measure with the Sāvitrī verse, O lord, / that which is proclaimed as “āpo hi ṣṭhā,” always [offered] to the sun in vain,

1.204.s:
yathānyāyaṃ tu saṃkṣālya pūrayeccānyato yataḥ ..
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatetyanayā kṣālayedbudhaḥ .. 6 ..
1.204.d:
यथान्यायं तु संक्षाल्य पूरयेच्चान्यतो यतः ॥
हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्ततेत्यनया क्षालयेद्बुधः ॥ 6 ॥
1.204.m: having washed it properly, one should fill it from another [vessel]; / the wise one should wash it with “hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartata.”

1.204.s:
savitā paścātātsavitā hyanayā pūrayedbudhaḥ ..
ityevaṃ pūrayitvā tu vāri puṣpākṣatairbudhaḥ .. 7 ..
1.204.d:
सविता पश्चातात्सविता ह्यनया पूरयेद्बुधः ॥
इत्येवं पूरयित्वा तु वारि पुष्पाक्षतैर्बुधः ॥ 7 ॥
1.204.m: The wise one should fill it with “savitā paścātāt savitā”; / having thus filled it with water, flowers, and unbroken grains, the wise one,

1.204.s:
pātramaudumbaraṃ gṛhya kṛtsnaṃ sūryasya darśayet ..
udutyaṃ jātavedasamanayā vyomni nikṣipet .. 8 ..
1.204.d:
पात्रमौदुम्बरं गृह्य कृत्स्नं सूर्यस्य दर्शयेत् ॥
उदुत्यं जातवेदसमनया व्योम्नि निक्षिपेत् ॥ 8 ॥
1.204.m: taking an udumbara vessel, should show it entirely to the sun; / he should cast it into the air with “ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam.”

1.204.s:
haṃsaḥ śuciṣaditi pādyaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
nirvāpayecca payasā khaṣolkaṃ snāpayettataḥ .. 9 ..
1.204.d:
हंसः शुचिषदिति पाद्यं दद्याद्विचक्षणः ॥
निर्वापयेच्च पयसा खषोल्कं स्नापयेत्ततः ॥ 9 ॥
1.204.m: With “haṃsaḥ śuciṣat” the discerning one should give foot-water; / and he should quench him with milk, and then bathe Khaṣolka.

1.204.s:
agnistu saptabhirvīra kīrtitāstāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
āpo hiṣṭheti ca kramāttisṛbhiḥ kurunaṃdana .. 10 ..
1.204.d:
अग्निस्तु सप्तभिर्वीर कीर्तितास्ताश्च कृत्स्नशः ॥
आपो हिष्ठेति च क्रमात्तिसृभिः कुरुनंदन ॥ 10 ॥
1.204.m: The [verses to] Agni are recited as seven, O hero, all of them in full; / and with the three beginning with “āpo hi ṣṭhā” in order, O joy of the Kurus,

1.204.s:
hiraṇyavarṇeti kramāccaturbhiśca narādhipa ..
abhimaṃtryodakamṛgbhistisṛbhi rnikṣipennṛpa .. 11 ..
1.204.d:
हिरण्यवर्णेति क्रमाच्चतुर्भिश्च नराधिप ॥
अभिमंत्र्योदकमृग्भिस्तिसृभि र्निक्षिपेन्नृप ॥ 11 ॥
1.204.m: and in order with the four beginning with “hiraṇyavarṇāḥ,” O lord of men; / having consecrated the water with these three verses, O king, he should pour it out.

1.204.s:
bhānoḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā kṛṇuṣvapāja ityapi ..
tya(itya)mūṣu vājinaṃ giraḥ prathamā parikīrtitā .. 12 ..
1.204.d:
भानोः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा कृणुष्वपाज इत्यपि ॥
त्य(इत्य)मूषु वाजिनं गिरः प्रथमा परिकीर्तिता ॥ 12 ॥
1.204.m: Having circumambulated the sun with “kṛṇuṣva pājaḥ,” / the first hymn of praise is proclaimed as “tam ū ṣu vājinaṃ giraḥ.”

1.204.s:
patimiṃdrastavācāma dvitīyā parikīrtitā ..
patimiṃdrastu śuddho na āgahi tṛtīyā parikīrtitā .. 13 ..
1.204.d:
पतिमिंद्रस्तवाचाम द्वितीया परिकीर्तिता ॥
पतिमिंद्रस्तु शुद्धो न आगहि तृतीया परिकीर्तिता ॥ 13 ॥
1.204.m: The second is proclaimed as “patim indraḥ stavācāma”; / the third is proclaimed as “patim indras tu śuddho na āgahi.”

1.204.s:
sidhye vṛtrāṇi jighne śagaṃdhairbhānuṃ prapūjayet..
asya vāmasyetyanayā akṣataiḥ pūjayedravim .. 14 ..
1.204.d:
सिध्ये वृत्राणि जिघ्ने शगंधैर्भानुं प्रपूजयेत्॥
अस्य वामस्येत्यनया अक्षतैः पूजयेद्रविम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.204.m: With “sidhye vṛtrāṇi jighne śa-,” one should worship the sun with perfumes; / with “asya vāmasya,” one should worship the sun with unbroken grains.

1.204.s:
sapta yuṃjaṃti rathamanayā pūjayedravim ..
puṣpairbharataśārdūla satataṃ tamanāśanam .. 15 ..
1.204.d:
सप्त युंजंति रथमनया पूजयेद्रविम् ॥
पुष्पैर्भरतशार्दूल सततं तमनाशनम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.204.m: With “sapta yuñjanti ratham,” one should worship the sun; / constantly worship that destroyer of darkness with flowers, O tiger of the Bharatas.

1.204.s:
ko dadarśa prathama manayā dhūpamādiśet ..
pākaḥ pṛcchāmyanayā caṃdanaṃ pratipādayet .. 16 ..
1.204.d:
को ददर्श प्रथम मनया धूपमादिशेत् ॥
पाकः पृच्छाम्यनया चंदनं प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 16 ॥
1.204.m: With “ko dadarśa prathamam,” one should offer incense; / with “pākaḥ pṛcchāmi,” one should offer sandalwood paste.

1.204.s:
uddīpyasyetyanayā dīpaṃ dadyādvibhāvasoḥ ..
arcitvā kuṃkumaṃ caiva śīrṣaṃ kṣīraṃ tu maṃḍalam .. 17..
1.204.d:
उद्दीप्यस्येत्यनया दीपं दद्याद्विभावसोः ॥
अर्चित्वा कुंकुमं चैव शीर्षं क्षीरं तु मंडलम् ॥ 17॥
1.204.m: With “uddīpyasva,” one should give a lamp to the sun; / having offered saffron, and [anointing] the head and the orb with milk,

1.204.s:
yuktā mātāsītyanayā naivedyaṃ pratipādayet ..
gaurīrmimāyeti dadyāttathā śukle ca vāsasī .. 18 ..
1.204.d:
युक्ता मातासीत्यनया नैवेद्यं प्रतिपादयेत् ॥
गौरीर्मिमायेति दद्यात्तथा शुक्ले च वाससी ॥ 18 ॥
1.204.m: with “yuktā mātāsīt,” one should present the food-offering; / with “gaurīr mimāya,” one should give two white garments.

1.204.s:
tasyāḥ samudretyanayā upavītaṃ nivedayet ..
iti saṃpūjya deveśaṃ tataḥ kuryātparāṃ stutim .. 19 ..
1.204.d:
तस्याः समुद्रेत्यनया उपवीतं निवेदयेत् ॥
इति संपूज्य देवेशं ततः कुर्यात्परां स्तुतिम् ॥ 19 ॥
1.204.m: With “tasyāḥ samudrāḥ,” one should present the sacred thread; / having thus worshipped the lord of gods, one should then make the supreme praise

1.204.s:
ṛgbhirvai paṃcabhistāta śṛṇu caikamanādṛtaḥ ..
ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśniriti ca prathamā parikīrtitā .. 20 ..
1.204.d:
ऋग्भिर्वै पंचभिस्तात शृणु चैकमनादृतः ॥
उक्षाणं पृश्निरिति च प्रथमा परिकीर्तिता ॥ 20 ॥
1.204.m: with five verses, dear one; hear them, attentive and with single mind: / the first is proclaimed as “ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśniḥ”;

1.204.s:
catvāri vāgiti bhaveddvitīyā parikīrtitā ..
iṃdraṃ mitraṃ tṛtīyā tu varādhikye prakīrtitā .. 21 ..
1.204.d:
चत्वारि वागिति भवेद्द्वितीया परिकीर्तिता ॥
इंद्रं मित्रं तृतीया तु वराधिक्ये प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 21 ॥
1.204.m: the second is proclaimed to be “catvāri vāk”; / the third, renowned for supreme excellence, is “indraṃ mitraṃ”;

1.204.s:
kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ hi tathā caturthī parikīrtitā ..
yo ratnavāhītyanayā kirīṭaṃ yojayedravau .. 22 ..
1.204.d:
कृष्णं नियानं हि तथा चतुर्थी परिकीर्तिता ॥
यो रत्नवाहीत्यनया किरीटं योजयेद्रवौ ॥ 22 ॥
1.204.m: and the fourth is proclaimed as “kṛṣṇaṃ niyānam”; / with “yo ratnavāhī,” one should affix a diadem to the sun.

1.204.s:
gatehanāmityanayā avyaṃgaṃ bhāskaraṃ nyaset ..
iyamadadādrabhasamṛṇacyutamiti ṛgāditaḥ .. 23 ..
1.204.d:
गतेहनामित्यनया अव्यंगं भास्करं न्यसेत् ॥
इयमददाद्रभसमृणच्युतमिति ऋगादितः ॥ 23 ॥
1.204.m: With “gatehanām,” one should place the avyaṅga girdle on the sun; / from the verse beginning “iyam adadād rabhasam ṛṇacyutam,”

1.204.s:
kṛtvā pūjāṃ tataścargbhiraṣṭābhiriti cācyuta ..
devasya śaktayo'ṣṭau ca pūjayedvidhivatkramāt .. 24 ..
1.204.d:
कृत्वा पूजां ततश्चर्ग्भिरष्टाभिरिति चाच्युत ॥
देवस्य शक्तयोऽष्टौ च पूजयेद्विधिवत्क्रमात् ॥ 24 ॥
1.204.m: having then performed worship with eight verses, O Acyuta, / one should worship the eight energies of the god in proper sequence according to rule.

1.204.s:
ityeṣa te mayākhyātaḥ pratimāpūjane vidhiḥ ..
yaḥ purokto mahābāho brahmaṇā viṣṇave tathā ..25..
1.204.d:
इत्येष ते मयाख्यातः प्रतिमापूजने विधिः ॥
यः पुरोक्तो महाबाहो ब्रह्मणा विष्णवे तथा ॥25॥
1.204.m: This rule for worshipping the image has been declared to you by me, / which was spoken of old by Brahmā to Viṣṇu, O mighty-armed one.

1.204.s:
anena vidhinā yastu satataṃ pūjayedravim ..
sa prāpnotyakhilānkāmāniha loke paratra ca ..26..
1.204.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु सततं पूजयेद्रविम् ॥
स प्राप्नोत्यखिलान्कामानिह लोके परत्र च ॥26॥
1.204.m: He who constantly worships the sun according to this rule / obtains all desires in this world and in the next.

1.204.s:
putrārthī labhate putrāndhanārthī labhate dhanam ..
kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ vedārthī vedavidbhavet ..27..
1.204.d:
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रान्धनार्थी लभते धनम् ॥
कन्यार्थी लभते कन्यां वेदार्थी वेदविद्भवेत् ॥27॥
1.204.m: One who desires sons obtains sons; one who desires wealth obtains wealth; / one who desires a maiden obtains a maiden; one who desires the Veda becomes a knower of the Veda.

1.204.s:
niṣkāmaḥ pūjayedyastu sa mokṣaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ ..
anena vidhinā pūjya gataḥ siddhiṃ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ .. 28 ..
1.204.d:
निष्कामः पूजयेद्यस्तु स मोक्षं प्राप्नुयान्नरः ॥
अनेन विधिना पूज्य गतः सिद्धिं स वैष्णवः ॥ 28 ॥
1.204.m: A man who worships without desire attains liberation; / having worshipped according to this rule, that Vaiṣṇava reaches perfection.

1.204.s:
brahmādayastathā devaṃ pūjayitvā vibhāvasum ..
anena vidhinā pūjya saṃtaḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ .. 29 .. ..
mahādevārcanavidhivarṇanam
1.204.d:
ब्रह्मादयस्तथा देवं पूजयित्वा विभावसुम् ॥
अनेन विधिना पूज्य संतः सिद्धिं परां गताः ॥ 29 ॥ ॥
महादेवार्चनविधिवर्णनम्
1.204.m:
Brahmā and the other gods, having thus worshipped the sun / according to this rule, being virtuous, attained the supreme perfection.
Description of the Rite of Worship by Mahādeva

1.205.s:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
punarnibodha me bhīṣma gadataḥ paramaṃ vidhim ..
yena pūjayate nityaṃ mahādevaṃ divā karam .. 1 ..
1.205.d:
॥ व्यास उवाच ॥ ॥
पुनर्निबोध मे भीष्म गदतः परमं विधिम् ॥
येन पूजयते नित्यं महादेवं दिवा करम् ॥ 1 ॥
1.205.m:
Vyāsa said:
Listen again, O Bhīṣma, as I proclaim the supreme rite / by which Mahādeva continually worships the sun, maker of the day:

1.205.s:
prabhūtaṃ nirmalaṃ teja ārādhya paramaṃ sukham ..
pūrvamaṃtastathāgneyyāṃ nairṛtyāṃ pavanālaye .. 2 ..
1.205.d:
प्रभूतं निर्मलं तेज आराध्य परमं सुखम् ॥
पूर्वमंतस्तथाग्नेय्यां नैरृत्यां पवनालये ॥ 2 ॥
1.205.m: having worshipped the abundant, spotless splendor, the supreme bliss, / first in the east, then inside in the south-east, in the south-west, in the abode of the wind,

1.205.s:
krameṇa yāvadīśānaṃ hṛdi bījaṃ ca vinyaset ..
bhāskarāsanametattu nyastavyaṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ .. 3 ..
1.205.d:
क्रमेण यावदीशानं हृदि बीजं च विन्यसेत् ॥
भास्करासनमेतत्तु न्यस्तव्यं तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ॥ 3 ॥
1.205.m: in order up to the north-east, one should also place the seed-syllable in the heart. / This seat of the Sun must be placed by those who perceive reality.

1.205.s:
upariṣṭāttatastasya hṛdayena tu paṃkajam ..
aṣṭapatraṃ keśarālaṃ paṃcavarṇasakeśaram .. 4 ..
1.205.d:
उपरिष्टात्ततस्तस्य हृदयेन तु पंकजम् ॥
अष्टपत्रं केशरालं पंचवर्णसकेशरम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.205.m: Then, above it, [one should place] a lotus with the heart-[mantra]— / eight-petaled, rich in filaments, five-colored, with stamens.

1.205.s:
dīptādi pūrvamārabhya āmahādevagocaram ..
śaktyaṣṭakaṃ nyasenmaṃtrairāditaḥ sarvatomukhīm .. 5 ..
1.205.d:
दीप्तादि पूर्वमारभ्य आमहादेवगोचरम् ॥
शक्त्यष्टकं न्यसेन्मंत्रैरादितः सर्वतोमुखीम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.205.m: Beginning from the east with Dīptā, extending into the realm of Mahādeva, / one should place the eight śaktis with mantras, beginning with Sarvatomukhī.

1.205.s:
abījaiḥ kesarāgreṣu krameṇaiva ca pūjayet ..
tatastvāvāhayedbhānuṃ sthāpayetkarṇikopari .. 6 ..
1.205.d:
अबीजैः केसराग्रेषु क्रमेणैव च पूजयेत् ॥
ततस्त्वावाहयेद्भानुं स्थापयेत्कर्णिकोपरि ॥ 6 ॥
1.205.m: One should worship [them] in succession at the tips of the filaments with the seed-syllables. / Then one should invoke the Sun and install him upon the pericarp.

1.205.s:
tasyopahṛtya taṃ cānyaṃ veditavyaṃ khapuṣkaram ..
tenaivāvāhanaṃ cārcya sthāpanaṃ cārdhameva ca .. 7 ..
1.205.d:
तस्योपहृत्य तं चान्यं वेदितव्यं खपुष्करम् ॥
तेनैवावाहनं चार्च्य स्थापनं चार्धमेव च ॥ 7 ॥
1.205.m: Having offered to him that other [offering], the sky-lotus should be known; / with that very [mantra] one performs the invocation, worship, installation, and arghya,

1.205.s:
pādyamācamanaṃ sthānaṃ vastragaṃdhādibhūṣaṇam ..
vidhinā vīrapuṣpāṇi naivedyaṃ dhūpameva ca .. 8 ..
1.205.d:
पाद्यमाचमनं स्थानं वस्त्रगंधादिभूषणम् ॥
विधिना वीरपुष्पाणि नैवेद्यं धूपमेव च ॥ 8 ॥
1.205.m: water for the feet, sipping water, placing, garments, scents and other ornaments, / vīra flowers according to rule, food offerings, and incense.

1.205.s:
kartavyaṃ śraddhayā bhaktyā evaṃ tuṣyati bhāskaraḥ ..
mahāpātakino'pyāśu labhaṃte ciṃtitaṃ phalam .. 9 ..
1.205.d:
