कर्तव्यं श्रद्धया भक्त्या एवं तुष्यति भास्करः ॥
महापातकिनोऽप्याशु लभंते चिंतितं फलम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.205.m: It should be performed with faith and devotion; thus the Sun is pleased. / Even great sinners quickly attain their desired fruit.

1.205.s:
ādityaṃ pūjayitvā tu paścādaṃgāni pūjayet ..
dīptāyāṃ hṛdayaṃ nyasya bhavānyā śiraso nyaset .. 10 ..
1.205.d:
आदित्यं पूजयित्वा तु पश्चादंगानि पूजयेत् ॥
दीप्तायां हृदयं न्यस्य भवान्या शिरसो न्यसेत् ॥ 10 ॥
1.205.m: Having worshipped the Sun, one should afterward worship the limbs: / placing the heart in Dīptā, one should place the head with Bhavānī.

1.205.s:
digvidikṣu nyasedastramiṃdrādi diśottarāṃtikam ..
karṇikāyāṃ nyasennetraṃ svabījena tu vārcayeta .. 11 ..
1.205.d:
दिग्विदिक्षु न्यसेदस्त्रमिंद्रादि दिशोत्तरांतिकम् ॥
कर्णिकायां न्यसेन्नेत्रं स्वबीजेन तु वार्चयेत ॥ 11 ॥
1.205.m: One should place the weapon in the cardinal and intermediate directions, ending at the north with Indra and the other directions. / One should place the eye in the pericarp, or worship it with its own seed-syllable.

1.205.s:
puṣpairgaṃdhaiśca dhūpaiśca hṛdayāni krameṇa tu ..
pūjayitvā tu vidhivadgarbhaṃ paścāttu maṃtravit .. 12 ..
1.205.d:
पुष्पैर्गंधैश्च धूपैश्च हृदयानि क्रमेण तु ॥
पूजयित्वा तु विधिवद्गर्भं पश्चात्तु मंत्रवित् ॥ 12 ॥
1.205.m: Having duly worshipped the hearts in sequence / with flowers, scents, and incenses, the knower of mantras should then [worship] the interior.

1.205.s:
bāhyataḥ pūrvato maṃdaṃ dakṣiṇena budhaṃ tathā ..
viṣāṇaṃ paścime pūjya uttareṇa tu bhārgavam .. 13 ..
1.205.d:
बाह्यतः पूर्वतो मंदं दक्षिणेन बुधं तथा ॥
विषाणं पश्चिमे पूज्य उत्तरेण तु भार्गवम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.205.m: On the outside, in the east Saturn, and in the south Mercury, / having worshipped Viṣāṇa in the west, and Venus in the north,

1.205.s:
āgneyyāṃ ca kujaṃ pūjya nairṛtyāṃ bhānudehajam ..
vāyavyāṃ pūjayetkṛṣṇamaiśānyāṃ vikacaṃ nṛpa .. 14 ..
1.205.d:
आग्नेय्यां च कुजं पूज्य नैरृत्यां भानुदेहजम् ॥
वायव्यां पूजयेत्कृष्णमैशान्यां विकचं नृप ॥ 14 ॥
1.205.m: having worshipped Mars in the south-east and the Sun's son in the south-west, / in the north-west one should worship Kṛṣṇa, and in the north-east Vikaca, O king.

1.205.s:
indrādilokapālāṃśca tato'ṣṭau pūjayedbudhaḥ ..
sugaṃdhairvividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpaiścaiva manoramaiḥ .. 15 ..
1.205.d:
इन्द्रादिलोकपालांश्च ततोऽष्टौ पूजयेद्बुधः ॥
सुगंधैर्विविधैः पुष्पैर्धूपैश्चैव मनोरमैः ॥ 15 ॥
1.205.m: Then the wise man should worship the eight world protectors beginning with Indra / with various fragrant flowers and pleasing incenses.

1.205.s:
krameṇa pūjayedbhānuṃ lokapālairgrahaiḥ saha ..
maṃtraiḥ kurukulaśreṣṭha ya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ .. 16 ..
1.205.d:
क्रमेण पूजयेद्भानुं लोकपालैर्ग्रहैः सह ॥
मंत्रैः कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ य इच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः ॥ 16 ॥
1.205.m: Whoever desires his own welfare, O best of the Kuru lineage, / should worship the Sun in succession together with the world protectors, planets, and mantras.

1.205.s:
anena vidhinā yatra devaḥ saṃpūjyate raviḥ ..
na caurāgnibhayaṃ tatra na cāpi narakādbhayam .. 17 ..
1.205.d:
अनेन विधिना यत्र देवः संपूज्यते रविः ॥
न चौराग्निभयं तत्र न चापि नरकाद्भयम् ॥ 17 ॥
1.205.m: Where the divine Sun is worshipped by this rite, / there is no fear of thieves or fire, nor any fear of hell.

1.205.s:
varṣopalaviṣādibhyo bhayaṃ tatra na vidyate ..
sukhamārogyamānaṃdaṃ subhikṣamacalāṃ śriyam .. 18 ..
1.205.d:
वर्षोपलविषादिभ्यो भयं तत्र न विद्यते ॥
सुखमारोग्यमानंदं सुभिक्षमचलां श्रियम् ॥ 18 ॥
1.205.m: No fear exists there from hailstorms, poison, and the like; / [there is] comfort, health, joy, abundance of food, and immovable prosperity.

1.205.s:
tejobiṃbāṃtamadhyastha ādityaḥ paramārthataḥ ..
yaṣṭavyaḥ sādhakairnityaṃ na ratho na ca vājinaḥ .. 19 ..
1.205.d:
तेजोबिंबांतमध्यस्थ आदित्यः परमार्थतः ॥
यष्टव्यः साधकैर्नित्यं न रथो न च वाजिनः ॥ 19 ॥
1.205.m: In ultimate truth, the Sun, abiding within the center of the orb of splendor, / is to be worshipped continually by practitioners—not the chariot and not the horses.

1.205.s:
ityeṣa vidhirākhyāto mayā bhīṣma tavākhilaḥ ..
yena pūjayate nityaṃ mahādevo divākaram .. 20 ..
1.205.d:
इत्येष विधिराख्यातो मया भीष्म तवाखिलः ॥
येन पूजयते नित्यं महादेवो दिवाकरम् ॥ 20 ॥
1.205.m: Thus this entire rite has been declared by me to you, O Bhīṣma, / by which Mahādeva continually worships the sun, maker of the day.

1.205.s:
itthaṃ pūjya vivasvantaṃ hṛdbījena visarjayet ..
ya evaṃ pūjayedbhānuṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 21 .. ..
sūryapūjāmāhātmyavarṇanam
1.205.d:
इत्थं पूज्य विवस्वन्तं हृद्बीजेन विसर्जयेत् ॥
य एवं पूजयेद्भानुं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥ 21 ॥ ॥
सूर्यपूजामाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
1.205.m:
Having thus worshipped Vivasvat, one should dismiss him with the heart's seed-syllable. / He who worships the Sun in this way attains the supreme state.
Description of the Greatness of Sun Worship
